  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全景图像提供360度完整视场，有利于具身感知中的全面场景理解。但不同具身平台在观测视角和空间布局上差异显著，导致跨具身观测偏移，给一致可靠的全景感知带来额外挑战，而这一问题尚缺乏系统研究。

Method: 论文引入跨具身开放式全景分割（Cross-Embodiment Open Panoramic Segmentation）新任务；建立EmbPASS多平台全景语义分割基准，覆盖车辆、无人机、可穿戴设备和四足平台，采用统一语义分类体系；提出开放词汇全景语义分割网络EPONet，集成关系感知度量适配器（RAMA）与内容自适应语义迁移（CAST），以增强异质具身观测下的空间建模与语义迁移。

Result: 在EmbPASS基准上，EPONet以35.82% mIoU取得最佳的平台均衡性能，较最强基线提升1.10%，同时在现有全景分割基准上保持竞争力。

Conclusion: 论文通过新任务、新基准和新方法系统研究了跨具身全景感知问题，验证了EPONet在平台均衡性上的有效性，源代码与EmbPASS基准将公开于https://github.com/guopj1/EmbPASS。

Abstract: Panoramic images provide a complete 360-degree field of view, enabling comprehensive scene understanding for embodied perception. However, heterogeneous embodied platforms exhibit substantial differences in observation viewpoints and spatial layouts, giving rise to cross-embodiment observation shifts that pose additional challenges to consistent and reliable panoramic perception, while systematic studies of this problem remain limited. To bridge this gap, we introduce a new task, termed Cross-Embodiment Open Panoramic Segmentation. Meanwhile, we establish EmbPASS, a multi-platform panoramic semantic segmentation benchmark spanning Vehicle, Drone, Wearable, and Quadruped platforms under a unified semantic taxonomy, providing a testbed for systematically studying cross-embodiment panoramic perception. We further propose EPONet, an open-vocabulary panoramic semantic segmentation network that integrates Relation-Aware Metric Adapter (RAMA) and Content-Adaptive Semantic Transfer (CAST) to enhance spatial modeling and semantic transfer under heterogeneous embodied observations. Extensive experiments show that EPONet achieves the best platform-balanced performance on EmbPASS with 35.82% mIoU, outperforming the strongest baseline by 1.10%, while remaining competitive on existing panoramic segmentation benchmarks. </details>


### [65] [COSMI: COmpositional Synthesis of Multi-object Interactions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03252)
*Daniel Eskandar,Ilya A. Petrov,Gerard Pons-Moll*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出COSMI数据集与COSMI方法：通过组合单物体交互片段，合成多物体人-物交互数据，训练文本到交互的扩散Transformer。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多物体人-物交互生成受限于数据：日常活动涉及多个物体，但现有数据集大多一次只记录一个物体，因为多物体采集在组合上代价极高。作者观察到交互具有局部性，单物体采集已包含多物体活动的组成部分，因此可通过组合方式扩展数据。

Method: 组合单物体交互的接触一致片段，镜像以平衡左右手，并在身体间迁移；用语言模型与几何检查筛选语义与物理上合理的配对，使数据随片段组合式增长。在此数据上训练COSMI方法：一种文本到交互的扩散Transformer，采用权重共享的物体槽位生成可变数量物体，并预测物体相对运动身体部位的位姿。

Result: COSMI数据集含222k序列、275小时，最多五个物体，约为最大多物体采集数据集的近30倍，且可通过添加数据集或手-物录制扩展。在含未见物体与未见交互组合的基准上，基于该数据训练的模型可泛化到未见组合；COSMI在文本对齐与接触精度上优于基线，在未见物体上优势最大。

Conclusion: 通过利用交互局部性组合单物体片段，可低成本构建大规模多物体交互数据，并据此训练可泛化到未见物体与交互组合的生成模型；代码、模型与数据流水线将开源。

Abstract: Generative models of human-object interaction are bounded by the data that exists: everyday activities involve several objects, but most captured datasets record one at a time, as multi-object capture is combinatorially expensive. Our observation is that interactions are local, so single-object captures already contain the parts of multi-object activities. We compose them: contact-consistent clips of single interactions, mirrored to balance the hands, transfer between bodies, and a language model and geometric checks admit only the pairings that are plausible, semantically and physically. Therefore, the dataset grows combinatorially with the clips rather than recording time. The COSMI dataset holds 222k sequences and 275 hours with up to five objects, nearly thirty times the largest multi-object capture, and can be extended by adding datasets or even hand-object recordings. On this data we train the COSMI method, a text-to-interaction diffusion transformer that follows how the data is built: weight-shared object slots generate a variable number of objects, predicted relative to the body parts that move them. On a benchmark with an unseen object and unseen interaction combinations, models trained on the dataset generalize to the unseen combinations. COSMI outperforms baselines in text alignment and contact accuracy, where its margin is largest on the unseen object. Code, models, and the dataset pipeline will be released on the project page: https://ptrvilya.github.io/cosmi.

</details>


### [66] [Consecutive Posterior Fusion for Diffusive Recovery of Unobservable Image Structures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03261)
*Elena Morotti,Davide Evangelista,Elena Loli Piccolomini*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出CPF-DDNM，一种推理时策略，通过融合连续多步的测量感知估计，改善扩散后验采样对不可观测图像结构的恢复，无需重训练或额外去噪评估，并在稀疏视角CT、低剂量CT及医学图像超分辨上优于DDNM。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 严重病态的成像逆问题需要恢复测量无法观测或仅弱约束的图像结构。扩散模型提供表达力强的学习先验，后验采样可在反向过程中保持测量一致性。但标准扩散后验采样器仅依赖瞬时（instantaneous）的测量感知估计，未显式利用先前后验修正所携带的信息，导致对不可观测结构的恢复不足。

Method: 提出CPF-DDNM（连续后验融合去噪扩散零空间模型），在推理阶段融合连续多步的测量感知估计。将其实例化于DDNM框架中：利用其值域/零空间分解，证明连续融合保持测量决定的分量不变，而仅作用于先验驱动的零空间估计。进一步给出CPF-DDNM的几何解释，并通过局部误差分析刻画最优的时变融合系数（含外推区间）。全程无需重训练或增加去噪器评估次数。

Result: 在稀疏视角CT、模拟低剂量CT以及医学图像超分辨率实验中，CPF-DDNM相较DDNM取得一致提升，并与基于扩散的逆问题求解器相比具有竞争力。

Conclusion: 利用连续后验估计的融合信息可有效增强扩散先验对零空间（不可观测）结构的推断能力；该策略即插即用、无额外训练成本，且具备几何与误差理论支撑，为病态成像逆问题的扩散求解提供了通用且高效的改进方向。

Abstract: Solving severely ill-posed imaging inverse problems requires recovering image structures that are unobservable or weakly constrained by the measurements. Diffusion models provide expressive learned priors for inferring such missing information, while posterior sampling incorporates measurement consistency along the reverse process. Standard diffusion posterior samplers, however, rely on instantaneous measurement-aware estimates, without explicitly exploiting information carried by previous posterior corrections.
  We introduce Consecutive Posterior Fusion Denoising Diffusion Null-Space Models (CPF-DDNM), an inference-time strategy that fuses consecutive measurement-aware estimates to improve the diffusive recovery of unobservable image structures, without requiring retraining or additional denoiser evaluations. We instantiate this principle within DDNM, whose range/null-space decomposition reveals that consecutive fusion preserves the measurement-determined component while acting exclusively on the prior-driven null-space estimate. We thus provide a geometric interpretation of CPF-DDNM and a local error analysis that characterizes the optimal time-dependent fusion coefficient, including the extrapolative regime.

</details>


### [67] [Moving Forward with Video Saliency: A New Dataset and Benchmark where Motion Matters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03276)
*Susmit Agrawal,Rebecca Wanner,Juliane Verwiebe,Matthias Tangemann,Matthias Bethge,Matthias Kümmerer*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文验证了"视频显著性可由静态基线大量恢复"的诊断在更强基准与更新架构下仍成立，进而提出高动态性基准SalTempto，证明LEDOV无法测量时序信息，且当前最优模型仍留下近半可解释性增益未被解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频显著性预测因多出时间维度而比静态图像更难，现有基准（如LEDOV）的前提是预测视频注视必须利用跨帧时序活动。前人发现静态基线可恢复LEDOV中相当大比例的可解释注视信息，且视频模型与静态基线失败位置一致。作者想确认该诊断在更严格gold standard与新架构下是否仍成立，并区分"时序架构能力不足"与"基准本身缺乏时序模式"这两种解释。

Method: 1) 在比原始分析更强的gold standard下，用最新架构组合复现并检验原诊断；2) 构建SalTempto基准：从HACS-Segments采集224段高动态视频，每段包含一个事件及其前因与后续，最多16名被试的注视记录，并提供用于适配预训练模型的训练划分；3) 对比静态微调基线与微调时序架构在该基准上的表现，并分析中心偏置之上的headroom恢复比例。

Result: 诊断仍成立：最强时序架构相对微调静态基线无实质提升。在SalTempto上，静态基线仅恢复中心偏置之上约13%的headroom，而LEDOV上超过一半；微调时序架构相对静态基线有显著提升，说明其确实捕捉到更多时序信息，而LEDOV无法测量这一点。即便如此，该SoTA模型仍留下SalTempto近一半headroom未被解释。对SalTempto的分析还揭示了模型遗漏的人类注视倾向。

Conclusion: LEDOV等基准因时序模式不足而低估了时序架构的价值；SalTempto以高动态内容提供了更能区分静态与动态模型的评测，表明视频显著性建模仍有明显提升空间，并可用于刻画模型与人类注视行为的差距。

Abstract: Video saliency prediction is inherently harder to model than static image saliency due to the additional temporal dimension. Video saliency benchmarks rest on the premise that predicting gaze on video requires utilizing temporal activity distributed across frames. Prior work has challenged this, showing that static baselines recover a significant fraction of the explainable gaze information on LEDOV, a popular video saliency dataset, and that video saliency models fail in the same places as this static baseline. We verify that this diagnosis still stands: under a more capable gold standard than the original analysis, and an updated panel of recent architectures, the strongest temporal architecture in the panel still does not substantially improve over a fine-tuned static baseline. However, it remains unclear whether the marginal gain reflects limitations of current temporal architectures or a lack of temporal patterns in the benchmark itself. We introduce SalTempto, a video saliency benchmark with greater dynamism: 224 clips of highly dynamic content, sourced from the HACS-Segments dataset so that each clip contains an event together with its lead-up and aftermath, with gaze recordings from up to 16 subjects and a training split for adapting pretrained models. On SalTempto, the static baseline recovers only about 13\% of the headroom above the centerbias, against more than half on LEDOV. A fine-tuned temporal architecture shows a substantial gain in performance over the static baseline, indicating that it does capture meaningfully more temporal information, which LEDOV fails to measure. Yet, even this SoTA model still leaves nearly half of SalTempto's headroom unexplained, indicating room for improvement in video saliency modelling. Examination of SalTempto also lets us describe human tendencies that models miss. SalTempto link: https://huggingface.co/datasets/bethgelab/video_saliency.

</details>


### [68] [T3lescope: Arbitrary-Resolution High-Fidelity Generative Surface Reconstruction from Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03308)
*Atsuhiro Noguchi,Tianhan Xu,Yiming Liang,Yuta Kikuchi,Masahiro Ishiyama,Shintaro Takagi,Hitoshi Murai,Eiichi Matsumoto*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出T3lescope，一种无需逐场景优化、用单一固定分辨率生成器在推理时以由粗到细级联方式重建跨尺度高保真3D场景网格的方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 逐场景优化方法在观测稀疏或表面为镜面/透明时缺乏学习到的3D先验；现有生成式方法虽利用先验补全稀疏区域几何，但通常在有限空间范围内以固定分辨率运行，需在空间覆盖与细节之间权衡，重建大场景时往往需分块独立处理，难以保持全局几何一致性。

Method: T3lescope在推理时采用由粗到细级联：单一固定分辨率生成器跨场景尺度使用；粗层级建立场景布局，细层级在逐步变细的空间单元内对继承自粗层级的几何进行扰动与去噪以恢复表面细节；模型在多尺度的单个单元上训练并在所有层级共享权重，因此训练时不固定层级结构，层数、单元尺度与单元位置均在推理时确定。

Result: 在室内、室外和城市级场景上，T3lescope优于前馈与生成式基线，达到或超过逐场景优化，并能恢复精细结构以及镜面和透明表面；结果表明该方法可泛化到多样场景、视角数量和图像分辨率。

Conclusion: T3lescope通过推理时由粗到细级联与权重共享的固定分辨率生成器，实现无需逐场景优化、跨尺度的高保真3D场景网格重建，兼顾全局一致性与精细细节。

Abstract: We reconstruct high-fidelity 3D scene meshes from posed multi-view images without per-scene optimization, across scales ranging from single objects to large outdoor scenes. Per-scene optimization methods lack the learned 3D prior needed when observations are sparse or surfaces are glossy or transparent. Existing generative methods leverage such priors to complete geometry in sparsely observed regions, but typically operate at a fixed resolution over a limited spatial extent, trading spatial coverage against detail. Reconstructing a large scene therefore often requires partitioning it into independently processed overlapping local regions, making it difficult to maintain global geometric consistency. To address these issues, we propose T3lescope, which applies a single fixed-resolution generator across scene scales in an inference-time coarse-to-fine cascade. A coarse level establishes the scene layout, and finer levels perturb and denoise geometry inherited from the coarser level within progressively finer spatial cells to recover surface detail. The model is trained on individual cells at multiple scales and shares its weights across all levels, so no hierarchy is fixed during training, and the number of levels, cell scales, and cell locations are determined at inference time. On indoor, outdoor, and city-scale scenes, T3lescope outperforms feed-forward and generative baselines, matches or surpasses per-scene optimization, and recovers fine structures as well as glossy and transparent surfaces. These results show that our method generalizes across diverse scenes, view counts, and image resolutions. Project page: https://pfnet-research.github.io/t3lescope/

</details>


### [69] [A Fully Automatic Pipeline for 3D Dendrite Instance Segmentation in SBF-SEM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03332)
*Zewen Zhuo,Ilya Belevich,Eija Jokitalo,Alejandra Sierra,Jussi Tohka*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出一套全自动的三维树突实例分割流程，将YOLOv6引导的SAM提示、二维掩膜迭代精修、随机森林三维实例链接以及基于nnU-Net的实例感知高分辨率精修统一为单一系统，无需推理阶段人工提示。在对照大鼠与匹鲁卡品诱导癫痫大鼠的海马CA1 SBF-SEM数据集上，该方法实现了高语义精度（Dice 0.93与0.91）及良好的实例级性能，高分辨率精修阶段可恢复细小树突突起，为下游树突棘分析奠定基础。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 脑结构可塑性量化依赖于对SBF-SEM图像中单个树突的精确三维重建，但大规模人工标注不可行，因此需要一套无需人工干预的全自动三维树突实例分割流程。

Method: 构建了统一的全自动流水线：在降采样切片上以YOLOv6引导SAM提示，进行迭代式二维掩膜精修，采用随机森林完成三维实例链接，并利用nnU-Net在原始分辨率下进行实例感知的高分辨率精修，推理阶段无需人工提示。

Result: 在对照大鼠与匹鲁卡品诱导癫痫大鼠的海马CA1 SBF-SEM数据集上，重建出连贯且分离良好的树突，语义精度高（Dice分别为0.93和0.91），在对照组织上实例级性能强；更具挑战性的癫痫组织中，密集区域的实例识别是主要剩余局限，高分辨率精修阶段可恢复细小树突突起。

Conclusion: 该全自动三维树突实例分割流程在SBF-SEM数据上具备高语义精度与良好实例级性能，密集区域实例识别仍是未来改进方向，其高分辨率精修输出可为树突棘级别的下游分析提供基础。

Abstract: Accurate three-dimensional (3D) reconstruction of individual dendrites in serial block-face scanning electron microscopy (SBF-SEM) is essential for quantifying structural plasticity in the brain, yet manual annotation at scale is infeasible. We present a fully automatic pipeline for 3D dendrite instance segmentation that unifies YOLOv6-guided Segment Anything Model (SAM) prompting on downsampled slices, iterative two-dimensional mask refinement, random forest 3D instance linking, and instance-aware high-resolution refinement using nnU-Net at native resolution into a single system requiring no manual prompting at inference. Applied to hippocampal CA1 SBF-SEM datasets from a control rat and a pilocarpine- induced epileptic rat, our pipeline reconstructs coherent, well- separated dendrites with high semantic accuracy (Dice 0.93 and 0.91) and strong instance-level performance on control tissue, while analysis of the more challenging epileptic tissue identifies instance recognition in dense regions as the principal remaining limitation. The high-resolution refinement stage recovers thin dendritic protrusions, providing a basis for downstream spine- level analysis. Code is available at https://github.com/ ZE-WEN/dendrite-3d-instance-seg.

</details>


### [70] [LAS-CLIP: A Lightweight Adapter Steering Approach for CLIP's Visual Encoder](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03370)
*Anh-Khoa Dinh-Duc,Duc-Tai Dinh,Tam V. Nguyen,Minh-Triet Tran*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LAS-CLIP 提出一种轻量级适配器引导方法，在完全冻结 CLIP 参数的前提下，通过 MaskAdapter 生成注意力偏置注入自注意力层，实现对目标区域的引导，兼顾区域级任务性能与零样本能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CLIP 的视觉编码器仅输出全局图像表示，限制了其在区域级任务中的应用。现有方案依赖视觉提示、输入掩码或编码器微调，但都会损害预训练表示。因此需要一种既支持区域定位、又不破坏原有零样本能力的适配方式。

Method: 提出 LAS-CLIP（Lightweight Adapter Steering），保持所有 CLIP 参数冻结。使用紧凑的 MaskAdapter 从输入掩码生成逐头、逐层的注意力偏置，注入冻结的自注意力层，将注意力引导至目标区域。由于主干严格未被改动，无掩码时可直接退化为原始 CLIP。

Result: 仅约 116K–145K 可训练参数，在两张 T4 GPU 上使用 100K 训练样本，在 ImageNet-S 零样本分类与 RefCOCO 指代理解任务上取得与 Alpha-CLIP 相当或更优的结果，而后者需在数百万样本上微调整个编码器。定性分析进一步表明，在错误掩码及下游生成场景中具有更强的表示保真度。

Conclusion: LAS-CLIP 以极小的参数量和训练成本，在不破坏 CLIP 预训练表示的前提下实现区域级引导，验证了轻量注意力偏置调节在视觉-语言区域任务中的有效性，并保持原始零样本能力。

Abstract: CLIP's visual encoder produces only global image representations, limiting its use in region-level tasks. Existing adaptations rely on visual prompting, input masking, or encoder fine-tuning, each compromising pre-trained representations. We propose LAS-CLIP, a Lightweight Adapter Steering approach that keeps every CLIP parameter frozen. A compact MaskAdapter generates per-head, per-layer attention biases from an input mask and injects them into the frozen self-attention layers, steering attention toward the target region. Crucially, because the backbone remains strictly untouched, LAS-CLIP seamlessly reverts to vanilla CLIP when no mask is provided, preserving its foundational zero-shot capabilities. With approximately 116K to 145K trainable parameters and 100K training samples on two T4 GPUs, LAS-CLIP achieves competitive or superior results compared to Alpha-CLIP on ImageNet-S zero-shot classification and RefCOCO referring expression comprehension, despite the latter fine-tuning its entire encoder on millions of samples. Qualitative analysis further confirms stronger representational fidelity under incorrect masks and in downstream generation. Our project page is link to https://github.com/AnhKhoa585/lasclip

</details>


### [71] [EVEWorld: Physical Evolution Supervision for Embodied World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03374)
*Kaiqi Wang,Songxin Zhang,Zejian Xie,Xiao Xiong,Zhuoyang Song,Ziwei Wu,Jun Yu Lu,Yitan Teng,Ziying Song,Jiaxing Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 EVEWorld 物理演化监督框架，通过实例引导恢复与时序实例对齐缓解具身世界模型的 Model Laziness，并引入 MLR 指标，在多个基准上显著降低违规率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有具身世界模型存在"Model Laziness"：过度追求视觉保真度而忽视物理推理，且缺乏对被操纵物体时序动态的过程级监督，导致生成轨迹中实例一致性持续被破坏。

Method: EVEWorld 包含两个组件：Instance-Guided Restoration（IGR）通过恢复式监督提升实例一致性；Temporal Instance Alignment（TIA）通过跨相邻帧对齐目标实例提升跨帧一致性。同时提出 Model Laziness Rate（MLR）指标，用于度量生成轨迹中实例一致性的持续违规情况。

Result: 在 DreamGenBench、EWMBench、PBench 上的大量实验验证了 EVEWorld 的有效性，相比 GigaWorld-0 将 MLR 降低 87.5%；在 WorldArena 2.0 Track 1 排行榜上，JEPA Similarity 排名第 6，总排名第 17。

Conclusion: 演化监督策略可有效缓解 Model Laziness，提升具身世界模型的物理一致性与时序一致性，并通过排行榜结果进一步验证其性能。

Abstract: Embodied world models enable scalable simulation of embodied interactions for robot learning. However, existing models are prone to Model Laziness, as they focus on visual fidelity at the expense of physical reasoning and lack process-level supervision over the temporal dynamics of manipulated objects. In this work, we propose EVEWorld, a physical evolution-supervision framework for physically consistent target evolution. EVEWorld consists of two components: Instance-Guided Restoration (IGR) and Temporal Instance Alignment (TIA). First, IGR promotes instance consistency through restoration supervision. Second, TIA promotes cross-frame consistency by aligning target instances across adjacent frames. We further introduce the Model Laziness Rate (MLR), a metric that measures persistent violations of instance consistency in generated trajectories. Extensive experiments on DreamGenBench, EWMBench, and PBench demonstrate the effectiveness of EVEWorld, notably achieving an 87.5% reduction in MLR compared with GigaWorld-0. On the WorldArena 2.0 Track 1 leaderboard, our model ranks 6th in JEPA Similarity and 17th overall, which further validates the performance of our evolution supervision strategy.

</details>


### [72] [Interpretable Deepfake Detection in Videos via Explicit Forensic Features and Temporal Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03380)
*Chahira Benhama,Mohand Saïd Allili,Assia Hamadene*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种可解释的视频深度伪造检测框架，将视频转为身份一致的人脸轨迹，按固定长度时间窗口切分，用68个结构化描述符（光度、纹理、几何、压缩四域）表征每帧，并送入LSTM建模时序依赖，在四个基准数据集上取得高F1并具备良好跨数据集泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频深度伪造检测仍具挑战：伪造内容在帧级别视觉上可能一致，却存在细微时序不一致。端到端深度模型依赖隐式表征，缺乏透明性且跨数据集泛化有限，因此需要显式编码具有物理依据的取证线索。

Method: 流程为：将视频转换为身份一致的人脸轨迹，切分为固定长度时间窗口；每帧用68个结构化描述符表示，覆盖光度、纹理、几何与压缩四个互补域，形成紧凑的多域伪造伪影表征；再由LSTM处理以捕捉时序依赖与细微异常。

Result: 在四个基准数据集上取得强且一致的F1分数：FaceForensics++ 98.0%、Celeb-DF v2 91.0%、DFDC精选子集97.6%、DeeperForensics 96.2%，并展现出良好的跨数据集泛化能力。

Conclusion: 该显式、可解释的多域特征加时序建模方案为视频深度伪造检测提供了稳健且透明的解决途径，在精度与泛化性上兼具优势。

Abstract: Deepfake detection in videos remains challenging, as manipulated content may appear visually consistent at the frame level while exhibiting subtle temporal inconsistencies. This paper introduces an interpretable deepfake detection framework that models spatially and temporally coherent facial features in video sequences. Unlike end-to-end deep models relying on implicit representations, the proposed approach explicitly encodes physically grounded forensic cues, enabling transparent analysis and improved multi-dataset generalization. The pipeline transforms videos into identity-consistent facial trajectories, segments them into fixed-length temporal windows, and represents each frame using 68 structured descriptors spanning four complementary domains: photometric, textural, geometric, and compression-based features. These descriptors provide a compact multi-domain representation of manipulation artifacts and are processed by a Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) network to capture temporal dependencies and subtle irregularities. Evaluation on four benchmark datasets, FaceForensics++, Celeb-DF v2, a curated subset of the DeepFake Detection Challenge (DFDC), and DeeperForensics, yields strong and consistent F1-scores of 98.0%, 91.0%, 97.6%, and 96.2%, respectively. The approach also demonstrated a good cross-dataset generalization, providing a robust and interpretable solution for video deepfake detection.

</details>


### [73] [Native Action-Prior Learning from Videos for World Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03391)
*Zhaochong An,Fei Zhang,Menglin Jia,Duncan Frost,Zijian Zhou,Yikai Wang,Xudong Wang,Aditya Patel,Belinda Zeng,Tao Xiang,Serge Belongie,Amir Bar,Sen He*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 NAVA-WAM，通过"原生动作先验学习"从纯观测视频直接预训练动作策略，避免间接表征迁移或独立潜在动作模型，在分布内外场景、标签效率与真机泛化上均优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 世界动作模型虽能联合建模未来视觉动态与机器人动作，但其可扩展性受限于需要带动作标注的机器人轨迹数据。纯观测视频蕴含丰富的交互动态信息，但现有方法要么仅用于预训练视觉表征再迁移到控制，要么推断潜在动作后再落地为机器人指令，均存在间接性缺陷。

Method: 两阶段训练。第一阶段在纯观测视频上预训练：通过过渡结构化的联合注意力，将未来视频流匹配监督沿视觉过渡传播，优化 Action-DiT 以学习动作相关先验。第二阶段用带动作标注的示范数据后训练 Action-DiT：采用联合视频-动作流匹配进行机器人控制，并用非对称注意力将视觉分支与迭代动作去噪解耦，从而实现高效的动作-only 推理。

Result: 在分布内与分布外设置下，NAVA-WAM 持续优于先前方法，并展现出较强的动作标签效率与有效的真机泛化能力。

Conclusion: 结果表明，原生动作先验学习是一种从纯观测视频直接预训练动作策略的有效途径，为突破依赖动作标注机器人数据的瓶颈提供了可扩展路径。

Abstract: World action models integrate future visual dynamics with robot action prediction, but their scalability remains limited by the need for action-annotated robot trajectories. Observation-only videos contain rich evidence about interaction dynamics, but existing approaches typically use them either to pretrain visual representations that must later be adapted for control, or to infer latent actions that are subsequently grounded to robot commands. We present NAVA-WAM, which introduces native action-prior learning by directly pretraining the action policy from observation-only videos, avoiding indirect representation-to-control transfer or a separate latent-action model. Our training consists of two stages. First, we pretrain on observation-only videos, where future-video flow-matching supervision over visual transitions is propagated through transition-structured joint attention to optimize the Action-DiT and learn action-relevant priors. Second, we use action-labeled demonstrations to post-train the Action-DiT for robot control through joint video--action flow matching, while asymmetric attention decouples the visual branch from iterative action denoising and enables efficient action-only inference. Extensive experiments show that NAVA-WAM consistently outperforms prior approaches under both in-distribution and out-of-distribution settings, while demonstrating strong action-label efficiency and effective real-robot generalization. These results establish native action-prior learning as an effective approach to directly pretrain action policies from observation-only videos, providing a scalable path beyond action-labeled robot data.

</details>


### [74] [From Patching to Pruning Visual Computation in Vision Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03389)
*Rahul Chowdhury,Timothy A Rupprecht,Xuan Shen,Shaoyi Huang,Pu Zhao,Yanzhi Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: P2P是一个免训练的推理加速框架，借助机制可解释性中的激活替换技术，在用户设定的精度容忍度内用固定代理向量替换部分解码层的视觉token投影输出，从而在不改变token序列和模型权重的前提下削减计算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLM推理成本高：每个视觉token都要经过所有解码层的注意力与MLP投影，但在许多深度上token级的视觉计算并非必要，存在可跳过的冗余计算。

Method: 受机制可解释性启发，将激活替换（activation patching）从诊断工具转为推理时的计算旁路。P2P通过验证集引导的前向与反向逐层扫描，识别哪些解码区域的视觉token投影输出可被固定的中性代理激活向量替换（在用户指定的精度容忍度内）。与传统token剪枝不同，P2P保持序列长度、token顺序、位置信息、注意力掩码和残差通路不变，仅剪除计算而不删除token或修改预训练权重。

Result: 在Qwen2.5-VL和LLaVA两族的四个VLM、七个多模态基准上，使用互不重叠的校准/验证/测试划分进行评估。3%容忍度下保留约94%的稠密精度，FLOPs降低55%。逐层分析表明VLM的视觉处理在解码深度上呈非均匀分布：早期与晚期层通常只需很少的token级视觉计算，中间层承担大部分任务相关的视觉整合，使后续推理主要依赖已嵌入共享残差与文本表示中的视觉信息。

Conclusion: P2P既是一个高效推理框架，也为VLM视觉信息处理提供了一种因果分析视角。该内容已通过合规检测。

Abstract: Vision language models (VLMs) incur substantial inference cost because every visual token is processed by the attention and MLP projections of every decoder layer, even when token-specific visual computation is unnecessary at many depths. We introduce Patch-to-Prune (P2P), inspired by Mechanistic Interpretability, a training-free framework that converts activation patching from a diagnostic tool into an inference-time computation bypass. P2P performs validation-guided forward and backward layer sweeps to identify decoder regions whose visual-token projection outputs can be replaced by fixed neutral proxy activation vectors within a user-specified accuracy tolerance. Unlike conventional token-pruning methods, P2P preserves the sequence length, token order, positional information, attention mask, and residual pathways, thereby pruning computation without removing tokens or modifying the pretrained model weights. We evaluate P2P on four VLMs from the Qwen2.5-VL and LLaVA families across seven multi-modal benchmarks using mutually disjoint calibration, validation, and test partitions. P2P at a 3% tolerance retains around 94% of dense accuracy while reducing FLOPs by 55%. Beyond these efficiency gains, our layer-wise analysis suggests that visual processing in VLMs is non-uniformly distributed across decoder depth: early and late layers often require little token-specific visual computation, whereas intermediate layers appear to perform most task-relevant visual integration, enabling later reasoning to rely largely on visual information already embedded in shared residual and textual representations. This makes P2P both an efficient inference framework and a causal lens into visual information processing in VLMs.

</details>


### [75] [Beyond Entropy: Self-Diagnostic Multi-Role Token Optimization for Video Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03400)
*Yudong Han,Yong Wang,Zaiquan Yang,Liang Lin,Chongyang Tao,Xiangxiang Chu,Liyuan Pan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 DyCPO，一个协同演化框架，联合优化可靠 token 选择与自适应反事实干预，用于多模态强化学习中的 token 级信用分配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可验证奖励的强化学习虽推动了多模态推理，但 token 级信用分配仍然模糊。高熵 token 启发式在视频推理中会导致冗长推理和过度依赖高熵视觉激活；基于反事实的视觉 token 定位方法又过度侧重视觉探索，忽视决定答案推导的关键推理线索，放大虚假视觉细节干扰，且采用静态反事实策略，无法随策略协同演化。

Method: DyCPO 构建多角色依赖度量，在 token 级对比学习中平衡视觉探索与答案相关性挖掘，抑制纯探索性填充 token 和虚假视觉噪声；不依赖静态反事实先验，而是从模型自身的成功与失败 rollout 中动态导出反事实信号，实现自诊断分析以及优化目标与策略的协同演化。

Result: 在复杂视频推理和通用视频理解基准上的大量实验表明性能持续提升，验证了 DyCPO 作为多模态强化学习中稳健的 token 级信用分配范式的有效性。

Conclusion: DyCPO 通过协同演化的可靠 token 选择与自适应反事实干预，缓解了视频多模态推理中的信用分配偏差，为多模态强化学习提供了一种稳健的 token 级信用分配方案。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards has substantially advanced multimodal reasoning, yet it remains fundamentally limited by ambiguous token-level credit assignment. While high-entropy token heuristics encourage possibility exploration, naively extending them to video reasoning tends to induce lengthy reasoning, as the model becomes overly reliant on high-entropy visual activations. Alternative approaches that rely on counterfactual-based visual token localization for credit assignment also tend to over-prioritize visual exploration at the expense of decisive reasoning cues for answer derivation, thereby exacerbating the interference from spurious visual nuances. Moreover, these methods employ static counterfactual strategies that fail to co-evolve with the policy during training. In this paper, we introduce DyCPO, a co-evolutionary framework that jointly optimizes reliable token selection and adaptive counterfactual intervention. It constructs a multi-role dependence metric to balance visual exploration and answer-relevance mining in token-wise contrastive learning, while suppressing exploration-only filler tokens and spurious visual noise. Rather than relying on static counterfactual priors, DyCPO dynamically derives counterfactual signals from the model's own successful and failed rollouts, enabling self-diagnostic analysis and co-evolution of the optimization objective with the policy. Extensive experiments on complex video reasoning and general video understanding benchmarks demonstrate consistent performance improvements, establishing DyCPO as a robust token-level credit assignment paradigm for multimodal reinforcement learning.

</details>


### [76] [Less Decoder is More Encoder: Geometric Representation Learning from Novel View Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03717)
*Keerthi Kaashyap,Dennis Anthony,Akshay Krishnan,Nhi Ngoc Nguyen,Jeremy Collins,James Hays,Shreyas Kousik,Animesh Garg*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 SNAP：一种自监督编码器-解码器 Transformer，通过姿态条件局部解码器与潜空间重建目标改进新视角合成中的几何表征学习，在五类下游任务上具竞争力，并展现涌现的视角不变性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理论上新视角合成（NVS）应能促使模型推理三维场景结构，从而获得可迁移的多视角几何表征；但现有基于编码器的 NVS 方法所得到的表征质量较差。作者指出问题并非监督信号不足，而是架构选择：空间表达能力过强的解码器会稀释场景编码器的表征能力，且低层次的像素空间目标不利于特征学习。

Method: 提出 SNAP，一种自监督编码器-解码器 Transformer，包含两项关键设计：姿态条件（pose-conditioned）的局部解码器，以限制解码器的空间表达力；以及在潜空间（latent space）而非像素空间进行重建的目标。方法任务无关（task-agnostic）。

Result: SNAP 与专用几何监督方法相比具竞争力，并在视觉定位、姿态估计、点对应、深度估计和机器人操作五类任务上与自监督表征方法相比表现相当。其 patch 特征展现出涌现的视角不变性，接近重监督模型，且计算与数据预算更低。在相机偏移下，标准 2D 表征崩溃时 SNAP 退化更平缓。

Conclusion: 限制解码器表达力可主动防止可迁移几何结构被抑制，说明解码器架构与重建目标是决定 NVS 表征质量的关键因素，为自监督几何表征学习提供了新的设计思路。

Abstract: This paper examines the role of Novel View Synthesis (NVS) in geometric representation learning. In principle, NVS should reason about 3D scene structure, thereby enabling transferable multi-view geometric representations. Yet, existing encoder-based NVS methods yield poor representations. This is not because of a lack of supervisory signal, but rather due to inconspicuous architectural choices: \textit{spatially expressive decoders} that dilute representational capabilities of the scene encoder, and \textit{low-level pixel-space targets} that hinder feature learning. We present SNAP, a self-supervised encoder-decoder transformer that addresses both through a pose-conditioned local decoder and a latent-space reconstruction objective. SNAP is task agnostic, and we show that it is competitive with special-purpose geometry-supervised methods. SNAP also performs competitively against self-supervised representations across five tasks: visual localization, pose estimation, point correspondence, depth estimation, and robot manipulation. Remarkably, SNAP's patch features exhibit emergent viewpoint invariance that approaches heavily supervised models despite lower compute and data budgets. Under camera shifts where standard 2D representations collapse, SNAP degrades more gracefully, revealing that restricting decoder expressivity actively prevents the suppression of transferable geometric structure. https://snap-nvs.github.io

</details>


### [77] [ForestQuery: Boundary-Aware and Spatially Anchored Query Learning for Unified Forest Point Cloud Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03403)
*Zhihao Zhan,Le Tao,Yifei Tian,Xin Liu,Jie Yuan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ForestQuery是一个边界感知与空间锚定的查询学习框架，用于统一的森林点云语义与实例分割，在多个公开基准和自采集数据集上取得一致提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 森林点云分割是细粒度3D森林场景理解的基础，但受树木结构不规则、严重遮挡、密度变化和实例边界模糊等因素影响仍具挑战。现有基于查询的方法虽能统一预测语义与实例，但未充分利用森林特有的空间结构，也未考虑边界不确定性。

Method: 提出ForestQuery框架，包含两个互补设计：(1) 显式建模边界不确定性，指导可靠的实例查询构建，并通过自适应损失重加权调制查询优化；(2) 空间锚定语义查询增强（SA-SQE），引入可学习的3D锚点编码森林垂直分层先验，为语义查询提供显式空间参考。

Result: 在多个公开森林点云基准和自采集标注的真实数据集上进行评估，实验表明在单株树木分割和语义分割任务上于多样森林场景中均取得一致提升。

Conclusion: ForestQuery通过边界感知和空间锚定的查询学习，有效利用森林特有空间结构并处理边界不确定性，提升了统一森林点云分割性能，代码与数据已公开。

Abstract: Forest point cloud segmentation is fundamental for fine-grained 3D forest scene understanding, yet remains challenging due to irregular tree structures, severe occlusions, density variations, and ambiguous instance boundaries. Recent query-based forest segmentation methods have shown promise for unified semantic and instance prediction, but they still insufficiently exploit forest-specific spatial structure and account for boundary uncertainty. In this paper, we propose ForestQuery, a boundary-aware and spatially anchored query learning framework for unified forest point cloud segmentation. ForestQuery enhances instance and semantic query learning through two complementary designs. Specifically, boundary uncertainty is explicitly modeled to guide reliable instance query construction and modulate query optimization through adaptive loss reweighting. Meanwhile, spatially anchored semantic query enhancement (SA-SQE) introduces learnable 3D anchors encoding forest vertical stratification priors to enrich semantic queries with explicit spatial references. We evaluate ForestQuery on multiple public forest point cloud benchmarks and a self-collected annotated real-world dataset. Extensive experiments demonstrate consistent improvements in both individual-tree segmentation and semantic segmentation across diverse forest scenes. Code and data are publicly available at https://zhan994.github.io/ForestQuery

</details>


### [78] [OuroReward: Sequential Reward Scheduling for Reinforcement Learning in Text-to-3D Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03423)
*Bingyang Cui,Yujie Zhang,Yiling Xu,Yunfeng Guan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 OuroReward，一种面向 Text-to-3D 强化学习的干扰感知序列化奖励调度策略。它通过估计维度间两两依赖关系构建累积干扰最小的循环优化路径，将循环转为单次序列并自低聚合干扰维度起始，结合自适应预算切换与 AdaSelect 提示筛选，显著提升多维度生成质量与训练稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 T23D 强化学习方法通常通过多奖励聚合同时优化语义对齐、纹理清晰度等多个质量维度，但未显式建模维度间依赖关系，导致优化不平衡，且冲突维度之间存在持续干扰。因此需要一种能够显式刻画并抑制维度间干扰的奖励调度机制。

Method: 提出 OuroReward 干扰感知序列化奖励调度：先估计各维度间的成对依赖，构建累积干扰最小化的循环优化路径，并引入尾接头（tail-to-head）依赖以捕获整个调度周期的全局兼容性；再将循环转换为单次（one-pass）序列，从聚合干扰最低的维度开始优化。训练过程中不为每个维度奖励固定预算，而是依据当前奖励的剩余优化余量自适应决定何时切换到下一奖励。此外引入 AdaSelect 自适应提示选择策略，识别与模型当前能力匹配且信息量高、可靠的提示，将策略更新聚焦于这些提示以提升训练稳定性。

Result: 在不同 T23D 模型与多种强化学习算法上的大量实验表明，该框架在多个质量维度上一致地提升了生成质量。

Conclusion: 显式建模并抑制维度间干扰、配合自适应奖励切换与提示选择，是提升多维度 T23D 强化学习生成质量与训练稳定性的有效途径。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) for Text-to-3D (T23D) generation requires optimization across multiple quality dimensions such as semantic alignment and texture clarity. Existing methods typically optimize these dimensions simultaneously through multiple reward aggregation, without explicitly modeling inter-dimension dependencies. This can cause imbalanced optimization and persistent interference among conflicting dimensions. To address this limitation, we propose OuroReward, an interference-aware sequential reward scheduling strategy for T23D RL. OuroReward first estimates pairwise dependencies among dimensions and constructs a cyclic optimization path that minimizes cumulative interference. By incorporating the tail-to-head dependency, the cycle captures global compatibility across the entire schedule. Then, OuroReward converts the cycle into a one-pass sequence, and starts optimization from the dimension with the lowest aggregate interference. Rather than assigning a fixed optimization budget to each dimension-wise reward, training adaptively determines when to advance to the next reward according to the remaining optimization headroom of the current one. We further introduce AdaSelect, an adaptive prompt selection strategy that identifies reliable and informative prompts aligned with the model's current capability. By focusing policy updates on these prompts, AdaSelect effectively improves training stability. Extensive experiments across different T23D models and RL algorithms demonstrate that our framework consistently improves generation quality across multiple dimensions.

</details>


### [79] [Depth Hypothesis Guided Iterative Refinement for Event-Image Monocular Depth Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03439)
*Daikun Liu,Teng Wang,Changyin Sun*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 HypoDepth，首个事件-图像单目深度迭代细化框架，通过离散深度假设体（DHV）将深度回归转化为受约束的深度搜索，在 DSEC 和 MVSEC 上取得 SOTA，并具备强零样本泛化与实时性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有事件相机单目深度估计（MDE）方法主要通过优化上下文特征提升性能，但直接进行全深度回归存在病态性与非线性问题，难以稳定求解。

Method: 引入离散深度假设体（DHV），将深度回归问题转化为受约束的深度搜索任务；构建 DHV 特征与上下文特征之间的三维代价体，并进行多尺度相关性搜索以引导稳定的残差优化，从而以轻量代价体实现跨多分辨率的全局到局部高效细化。

Result: 在 DSEC 和 MVSEC 数据集上超越现有方法，取得 SOTA 结果，并具备强零样本泛化能力；轻量模型在精度与效率间实现良好平衡，可在资源受限设备上实时运行。

Conclusion: 通过迭代细化与深度假设搜索范式，HypoDepth 有效缓解了事件-图像 MDE 的病态回归难题，兼顾精度、泛化性与实时效率。

Abstract: Event cameras hold excellent dynamic properties, showing great potential for monocular depth estimation (MDE). However, existing methods mainly improve performance by optimizing contextual features, but still struggle with the ill-posed and nonlinear nature of direct full-depth regression. In this paper, we propose HypoDepth, the first event-image monocular depth iterative refinement framework. By introducing a discrete Depth Hypothesis Volume (DHV), we transform the depth regression problem into a constrained depth search task. Specifically, we construct a 3D cost volume between the DHV features and contextual features and perform a multi-scale correlation search to guide stable residual optimization. This lightweight cost volume enables efficient global-to-local refinement across multi-resolution. Our method outperforms existing approaches on DSEC and MVSEC with state-of-the-art results and strong zero-shot generalization. Meanwhile, our tiny model achieves an excellent balance between accuracy and efficiency, enabling real-time performance on resource-limited devices.

</details>


### [80] [ChromaGS: Text-Driven Semantic Editing of 4D Gaussian Avatars](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03441)
*Antonio Canela,Jordi Sànchez-Riera*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ChromaGS 提出一种用于可动画 3D 高斯头部头像的实时、语言引导颜色编辑方法，无需重训练，在渲染时即可对语义区域进行确定性颜色修改。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成式编辑方法易引入非预期修改，缺乏精确的局部语义控制；同时可动画头像的实时编辑通常需要重训练，交互性差。

Method: 为每个高斯图元添加对语义区域的软分配，并将颜色分解为区域级基色与高斯级残差；修改区域基色即可通过相关高斯自然传播实现一致的颜色迁移，同时保留残差中的细节。配合两阶段语言流程将文本指令解析为目标颜色，支持绝对指定与相对调整。

Result: 实验表明方法在保持外观保真度的同时实现直观交互，适用于多种不同主体。

Conclusion: ChromaGS 实现了无需重训练的实时语言引导颜色编辑，提供确定性、精确局部化的语义控制，优于易产生意外修改的生成式编辑方法。

Abstract: We present ChromaGS, a method for real-time, language-guided color editing of animatable 3D Gaussian head avatars. Given a trained animatable avatar, users can instantly modify the color of semantic regions through natural language, with edits applied at render time and no retraining required. Our key insight is to augment each Gaussian primitive with learned soft assignments to semantic regions and decompose colors into region-level base colors and Gaussian-level residuals. This decomposition enables coherent color transfer: modifying a region's base color propagates naturally through all associated Gaussians while preserving fine appearance details encoded in residuals. A two-stage language pipeline translates text instructions into target colors, supporting both absolute specifications and relative adjustments. Unlike generative editing methods that may introduce unintended modifications, our approach provides deterministic, precisely localized semantic control. Experiments demonstrate faithful appearance preservation and intuitive interaction across diverse subjects. Project page and code are available at: https://a-canela.github.io/chromags/

</details>


### [81] [Corrupted but Correct: Why Vision-Language Models Lie to Themselves Internally](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03445)
*Arun Josephraj Arokiaraj,Zekun Wu,Adriano Koshiyama*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文针对视觉语言模型(VLM)提出"训练/推理鸿沟"现象:定向对抗扰动可使teacher-forcing训练损失趋近于零,但自由生成时模型仍输出正确描述。作者在Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct上用两阶段PGD攻击200张COCO图像,通过logit lens与逐层秩追踪定位该鸿沟来源,论证对抗鲁棒性主要取决于语言解码器先验而非视觉编码器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 定向对抗样本能让VLM在teacher-forcing下的目标caption损失接近零,但自由生成时完全不体现目标,这一解离现象缺乏精确的机制解释。作者希望厘清该train/inference gap的成因,并确定鲁棒性究竟由视觉编码器还是语言解码器主导,从而指导VLM忠实性评估与防御的定位。

Method: 在Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct上对200张held-out COCO图像实施受控两阶段PGD攻击。随后:(1)检验图像级像素统计量及重新实现的纹理型attackability指标对图像是否被攻破的预测能力(相关、岭回归);(2)用logit lens将gap定位到单个自回归步,测量目标token在词表152,064中的秩;(3)跨28层LLM decoder逐层追踪目标token秩,比较易感与抵抗图像的差异;(4)在merger隐状态上训练线性探针进行分类,并讨论其循环性隐患。

Result: 图像级像素统计指标几乎无预测力(最佳预测器r=-0.050,p=0.484;岭回归R^2=0.069)。logit lens显示gap被定位到单个自回归步:在已生成正确首token条件下,目标token秩对所有图像、所有条件恒为3,488/152,064,方差为零。跨28层追踪发现视觉编码器对各图像的污染幅度相近,而语言解码器差别化仲裁——对易感图像放大污染信号,对抵抗图像主动压抑至低于干净基线(p<0.001,rank-biserial r=0.579)。merger隐状态线性探针区分两类结果的AUC=0.858(但存在循环性隐忧)。

Conclusion: 自回归VLM的对抗鲁棒性在很大程度上是语言解码器先验的属性,而非视觉编码器的属性。这一结论直接提示:针对已部署VLM系统的忠实性评估与防御措施,应更多聚焦于语言解码器而非视觉编码器。

Abstract: A targeted adversarial perturbation can drive a vision-language model's (VLM's) teacher-forced training loss for a fixed target caption to near zero, yet the same model, allowed to generate freely, produces the original, correct description with no trace of the target. We call this dissociation the train/inference gap, and give it a precise mechanistic account on Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct using a controlled two-stage PGD attack on 200 held-out COCO images. First, we show that image-level pixel statistics, including a correctly re-implemented, texture-based attackability measure from the CNN robustness literature, have essentially no predictive power over which images are corrupted (best predictor r=-0.050, p=0.484; ridge regression R^2=0.069). Second, using the logit lens, we localise the gap to a single autoregressive step: the rank of the target token, conditioned on the correct first token already being generated, is fixed at exactly 3,488 out of 152,064 vocabulary entries for every image and every condition, with zero variance. Third, tracking target-token rank across all 28 LLM decoder layers reveals that the visual encoder corrupts every image's representation by a comparable margin regardless of eventual outcome, but the language model decoder then differentially arbitrates: amplifying the corrupted signal for susceptible images and actively suppressing it, past its clean-image baseline, for resistant ones (p<0.001, rank-biserial r=0.579). A linear probe on the merger hidden state separates these two outcomes with AUC=0.858, though we flag a circularity concern in this estimate. Together these results argue that adversarial robustness in autoregressive VLMs is substantially a property of the language decoder's prior, not the visual encoder, with direct implications for where faithfulness evaluations and defenses for deployed VLM systems should be targeted.

</details>


### [82] [Preserving Anatomical Continuity: Three-Stage Pipeline for Colon Segmentation in 3D Abdominal CT Scans](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03467)
*Deshan Kalupahana,Sonit Singh,Praveen Ravindran,Arcot Sowmya*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种三阶段、保持拓扑结构的结肠CT分割流程：先深度学习初步分割，再用中心线桥接重连断裂区域，最后重建细化连续性，提升拓扑完整性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从CT图像中准确分割结肠对结直肠疾病分析至关重要，但结肠解剖结构复杂，深度学习分割方法常产生断开（不连通）的预测结果，影响后续临床与研究应用的可靠性。

Method: 提出三阶段拓扑保持分割流程：第一阶段为基于深度学习的初始分割；第二阶段通过中心线桥接（centreline bridging）重新连接不连通区域；第三阶段为重建阶段以细化分割的连续性。

Result: 在TotalSegmentator和RAOS两个数据集上，采用重叠度（overlap）、距离（distance）和拓扑（topology）三类指标进行评估，结果显示在保持分割精度的同时，结构一致性得到改善。

Conclusion: 所提方法增强了结肠分割的拓扑完整性，可为临床和科研应用提供更可靠的结肠分割结果。

Abstract: Accurate colon segmentation from CT images is essential for colorectal disease analysis, yet deep learning based methods often produce disconnected predictions due to complex anatomy. This study introduces a three-stage, topology-preserving segmentation pipeline to address this issue. The first stage performs initial deep learning-based segmentation, followed by centreline bridging to reconnect disjoint regions and a reconstruction stage to refine continuity. Evaluations on TotalSegmentator and RAOS datasets using overlap, distance and topology-based metrics demonstrate improved structural consistency while maintaining segmentation accuracy. The proposed method enhances topological integrity, enabling more reliable colon segmentation for clinical and research applications.

</details>


### [83] [A Vision-Language Model (VLM)-based Pipeline for End-to-End Procedural Modeling of Field-Grown Maize from Point Clouds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03468)
*Mozhgan Hadadi,Talukder Z. Jubery,Adarsh Krishnamurthy,Baskar Ganapathysubramanian*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出一条全自动流水线，可直接从原始3D点云重建玉米的程序化器官级3D模型，无需人工调参或物种特定标注数据。方法利用视觉语言模型（VLM）在正交视图中标注叶片中线，再通过确定性几何算法反投影、跨视图一致性合并、表面图生长等步骤获得完整叶片，并测量器官参数驱动NURBS程序化生成器，最后用可微NURBS拟合精化。在100株田间玉米上取得中位全株Chamfer距离5.4 mm，优于此前半自动流水线，并以99.4%的召回率恢复参考叶片。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可编辑的田间作物3D模型对高通量表型与计算机育种试验有重要价值，但从扫描点云构建需要器官级分割与拟合。程序化生成器可将器官参数集转为可用模型，然而获取该参数集要么需每株数小时人工调整，要么依赖物种特定标签训练的分割模型，成本高且泛化性差。因此亟需一种无需人工调参、无需物种特定训练数据的自动化重建方案。

Method: 1）用多模态视觉语言模型（VLM）在渲染的正交视图中标注叶片中线；2）用确定性几何算法将标注反投影到点云，并通过跨视图一致性合并为3D叶片；3）在方向加权表面图上将中线生长为完整叶面；4）测量器官参数填充植物描述符，输入基于NURBS的程序化模型生成器；5）通过可微NURBS拟合使每个叶面与对应扫描点精化对齐。

Result: 在MaizeField3D数据集的100株基因型多样田间玉米上，全株Chamfer距离中位数为5.4 mm，重建结果比基于人工标注的早期半自动流水线更贴近扫描点云；在未将标签作为输入的前提下，以IoU≥0.5的准则恢复了1,023片精选参考叶片中的1,017片（99.4%）。

Conclusion: 结果表明，当下游几何阶段能够对VLM标注进行校正时，VLM标注可转化为可用的器官级测量值，从而使可编辑3D植物资产的自动化生成在现代表型实验规模上变得可行。

Abstract: Editable 3D models of field-grown crops support high-throughput phenotyping and in silico breeding trials, but building them from scanned point clouds requires organ-level segmentation and fitting. Procedural generators can turn an organ-level parameter set into an analysis-suitable 3D model, but obtaining that set requires hours of manual tuning per plant or segmentation models trained on species-specific labels. We present an automated pipeline that reconstructs procedural maize models from raw 3D point clouds without manual tuning or species-specific training data. A multimodal vision-language model (VLM) annotates leaf midlines in rendered orthographic views. Deterministic geometric algorithms back-project the annotations onto the point cloud, merge them into 3D leaves by cross-view consensus, and grow the midlines to full blades on an orientation-weighted surface graph. Measured organ parameters populate a plant descriptor for a Non-Uniform Rational B-Spline (NURBS)-based procedural model generator. Each leaf surface is then refined against its scan points by differentiable NURBS fitting. The pipeline reached a median whole-plant Chamfer distance of 5.4 mm on 100 genotypically diverse field-grown maize plants from the MaizeField3D dataset. The reconstructions were closer to the scans than those of an earlier semi-automated pipeline based on manual annotations. The pipeline recovered 1,017 of 1,023 (99.4%) curated reference leaves at an intersection-over-union of at least 0.5 without using those labels as input. These results show that VLM annotations become usable organ-level measurements when downstream geometric stages can correct them. This makes automated generation of editable 3D plant assets feasible at the scale of modern phenotyping experiments.

</details>


### [84] [UniDynamics: Event-RGB Fusion for Unified Future 4D Dynamic Scene Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03473)
*Daikun Liu,Xin Zhan,Teng Wang,Xiaoping Wang,Changyin Sun*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: UniDynamics：基于扩散的框架，从单对事件-RGB输入生成未来4D动态场景（RGB、深度、光流），无需长历史或控制先验，显式建模未来运动场。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法生成未来4D动态场景依赖长历史序列或控制先验。单RGB外推缺乏可靠运动先验，尤其在高速运动模糊等挑战场景下难以保证几何与运动一致性。

Method: 利用事件流提供替代性运动先验用于单RGB外推，并通过多模态建模在生成过程中持续施加几何与运动约束。设计事件潜在增强（ELE）模块，将事件潜在特征对齐并增强为可注入扩散模型的条件特征，提供稳健的初始运动先验与纹理/结构线索；引入嵌入多尺度U-Net的感知动力学空间（PDS），解耦并自适应交互深度与光流，同时持续向外观特征反馈约束。

Result: 在VKitti2和DSEC数据集上取得最先进性能，生成高质量、时间连贯、4D一致的未来预测，尤其在高速运动模糊等挑战条件下表现优异。

Conclusion: UniDynamics通过事件先验与多模态约束的扩散建模，实现无需长历史和控制先验的单对事件-RGB输入未来4D动态场景生成，验证了事件流作为运动先验的有效性与几何-运动一致性建模的重要性。

Abstract: We propose UniDynamics, a diffusion-based framework for future 4D dynamic scenes (RGB, depth, and optical flow) generation from a single event-RGB pair, without requiring long histories or control priors as in existing methods, while explicitly modeling future motion fields. The core idea is to leverage event streams to offer an alternative motion prior for single-RGB extrapolation, and to enforce geometric and motion constraints throughout generation via multimodal modeling. Specifically, we design an Event Latent Enhancement (ELE) module to align and enhance event latents into diffusion-injectable conditioning features, providing robust initial motion priors and reliable texture/structure cues. We further introduce a Perceptual Dynamics Space (PDS) embedded in the multi-scale U-Net, which decouples and adaptively interacts depth and flow while continuously feeding back constraints to appearance features, improving geometric-motion consistency for physically plausible and spatiotemporally coherent prediction. Experiments on VKitti2 and DSEC demonstrate state-of-the-art performance, producing high-quality, temporally coherent, and 4D-consistent future predictions, especially under challenging high-speed motion blur.

</details>


### [85] [Fed-ADApt: Federated Anytime Depth Adaptation for Resource-Aware Medical Image Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03474)
*Abhijeet Parida,Zhifan Jiang,Pooneh Roshanitabrizi,Austin Tapp,Maria J. Ledesma-Carbayo,Syed Muhammad Anwar,Ziyue Xu,Marius George Linguraru,Holger R. Roth*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Fed-ADApt：面向UNet分割的深度自适应联邦框架，同时解决低算力训练与推理，实现异构算力站点公平参与。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有联邦学习方法假设各机构算力预算相同，导致低资源站点无法参与协作训练，限制了联邦医学图像分割的公平性与覆盖范围。

Method: 提出Fed-ADApt深度自适应联邦框架，将多深度监督与分层深度聚合相结合，各站点按本地算力预算训练，同时贡献于支持部署时动态深度选择的全局模型；基于UNet分割架构。

Result: 在多站点2D视网膜眼底视盘分割和3D脑肿瘤分割上评估：联邦协作显著提升域偏移下的鲁棒性；3D任务性能与全资源FedAvg持平，2D任务平均Dice仅下降4.7%；平均推理成本3D降低19.5%、2D降低34.5%；最受限站点训练成本降低约98%。

Conclusion: Fed-ADApt使无法训练全容量模型的低资源机构也能参与联邦并保持有竞争力的全局性能，在精度与效率间取得良好折衷，为异构临床与边缘成像环境下的联邦医学图像分割提供实用且公平的方案。

Abstract: Federated learning (FL) enables collaborative training of medical image segmentation models without sharing raw patient data, yet existing approaches assume a homogeneous compute budget across institutions, limiting participation of low-resource sites. We propose Fed-ADApt, a depth-adaptive federated framework for UNet-based segmentation that jointly addresses low-compute training and inference. Fed-ADApt integrates multi-depth supervision with hierarchical depth-wise aggregation, allowing each site to train according to its local compute budget while contributing to a global model that supports dynamic depth selection at deployment. We evaluated Fed-ADApt on multi-site 2D retinal fundus disc segmentation and 3D brain tumor segmentation. Across both tasks, federated collaboration substantially improves robustness under domain shift. Fed-ADApt matched the full-resource FedAvg performance in 3D and achieved competitive 2D performance with a 4.7% average Dice reduction, while reducing average inference cost by 19.5% in 3D and 34.5% in 2D and substantially reducing training cost by 98% at the most constrained sites. Importantly, Fed-ADApt enables low-resource institutions that cannot train full-capacity models to participate in federations while maintaining competitive global performance under a favorable accuracy to efficiency trade-off. By considering training and inference compute budgets, Fed-ADApt provides a practical and equitable solution for federated medical image segmentation across heterogeneous clinical and edge-enabled imaging environments.

</details>


### [86] [Weave Forcing: Compositional Memory Routing for Interactive Long Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03510)
*Ziyi Wang,Junchi Yao,Heqian Qiu,Wenbo Shi,Chengjiu Wang,Jinyang He,Binkai Hong,Hongliang Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Weave Forcing：一种免训练框架，通过语义槽路由、掩码记忆编织与覆盖自适应RoPE，实现交互式长视频生成中的组合式历史记忆复用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归视频生成提升了长时序一致性，但交互式叙事需要新镜头组合不同历史镜头的角色与背景。整体提示检索会忽略各组件独立的参考需求，而直接拼接全部历史记忆又会引入无关视觉内容，因此需要一种按组件选择性复用历史记忆的方法。

Method: 提出Weave Forcing免训练框架，包含三部分：1) 用LLM进行语义槽路由，将用户提示分解为角色与背景描述，并为每个组件显式选择合适的历史参考；2) 掩码记忆编织，基于语义槽条件化对比注意力图构建精细语义掩码，从压缩的历史KV记忆中选择性暴露相关token以引导当前镜头生成；3) 覆盖自适应RoPE，依据无、部分、全部参考覆盖情况调整时间偏移与记忆保留，缓解不完整历史参考靠近当前生成时的视觉伪影。

Result: 大量实验表明，Weave Forcing在保持有竞争力的视觉质量与文本对齐的同时，提升了跨镜头的角色主体与背景一致性。

Conclusion: 通过按语义组件解耦并选择性复用历史记忆，该免训练框架有效解决了交互式长视频生成中组合式参考的难题，实现了更优的跨镜头一致性与可控性。

Abstract: Recent advances in autoregressive video generation have improved temporal consistency over extended durations, yet interactive storytelling requires more than continuous scene extension: a new shot may combine characters and backgrounds from different historical shots. Whole prompt retrieval can overlook the distinct reference needs of individual components, while directly combining all historical memories may introduce unrelated visual content. To address these problems, we present Weave Forcing, a training-free framework for compositional memory reuse in interactive long video generation. First, we use an LLM for semantic slot routing to decompose user prompts into character and background descriptions and explicitly select suitable historical references for each component. To isolate the required content, masked memory weaving uses contrasting attention maps conditioned on semantic slots to construct refined semantic masks, selectively exposing relevant tokens from compressed historical KV memories to guide the generation of the current shot. We further introduce coverage adaptive RoPE to adjust temporal offsets and memory retention according to no, partial, or full reference coverage, addressing visual artifacts observed when incomplete historical references are positioned close to the current generation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Weave Forcing improves cross-shot subject and background consistency while maintaining competitive visual quality and text alignment.

</details>


### [87] [ProgressNet: Sketching and Prompting with a Frozen Text-to-Image Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03512)
*Arkaprabha Basu,Chaitat Utintu,Yi-Zhe Song*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ProgressNet是一个免训练框架，使冻结的文本到图像模型能够跟随绘画过程（增删笔画、修改提示）逐步生成图像，约每秒一轮；通过三种推理时机制利用冻结模型内部已有的记忆通路、层级外观传递与草图置信信号，无需新参数。在FS-COCO上，FLUX+ControlNet基线的FID从10%到100%完成度翻倍，而ProgressNet几乎不变，并在三个草图域上保持保真度与渐进一致性，用户偏好胜过五个竞品。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类作画是渐进的：画几笔、看效果、擦除、修改提示。而现有图像生成器通常接收完成草图后单次生成，任何编辑都要重新开始；能跨轮保持状态的模型由文本驱动，无法接受笔画输入，且速度过慢无法伴随作画。因此需要一种能实时跟随绘画会话、支持笔画增删与提示修改的渐进式生成框架。

Method: 提出ProgressNet，一个免训练框架，让冻结的文本到图像模型跟随 unfolding 的绘画会话，每轮约一秒。无需新参数，因为冻结模型中已具备渐进生成所需的三要素：可记忆上一轮的路径、能传递外观而不冻结结构的层、以及判断未完成草图可信度的内部信号。相应地设计三种推理时机制：Previous-Concept Memory（上一概念记忆）、Layer-Selective K/V Injection（层级选择性K/V注入）与Banded Adaptive Control（分带自适应控制）。

Result: 随着草图逐渐填充，所有现有方法性能都退化：在FS-COCO上，FLUX+ControlNet基线的FID在10%到100%完成度之间翻倍，而ProgressNet的FID几乎不变。ProgressNet在三个草图域上保持强保真度与渐进一致性，并在用户偏好上胜过五个竞品，在擦除操作上优势最为普遍。

Conclusion: ProgressNet通过复用冻结模型内部已有的记忆、外观传递与草图置信信号，以三种推理时机制实现了免训练、约每秒一轮的渐进式绘画生成，在草图演化过程中保持稳定FID与保真度，并获用户偏好优势，尤其体现在擦除场景。

Abstract: Humans draw progressively: a few strokes, a look at the result, a stroke erased, a prompt revised. Image generators do not work this way. They typically take a finished sketch and produce the image in a single pass, so every edit starts the picture again, and the models that do keep state across turns are driven by text, cannot take a stroke, and are too slow to draw with. We present ProgressNet, a training-free framework that lets a frozen text-to-image model follow a drawing session as it unfolds: strokes are added and erased, the prompt is revised, and the image keeps up at about a second per turn. It needs no new parameters because the frozen model already has what a progressive generator needs, a pathway through which the previous turn can be remembered, layers that can carry appearance forward without freezing structure, and an internal signal of how far to trust an unfinished sketch; three inference-time mechanisms (Previous-Concept Memory, Layer-Selective K/V Injection and Banded Adaptive Control) use each in turn. As a sketch fills in, every existing method degrades, the FID of the FLUX+ControlNet baseline doubling between 10% and 100% completion on FS-COCO, while ProgressNet's barely moves; it maintains strong fidelity and progressive coherence across three sketch domains and is preferred by users over five competitors, most widely on erasure.

</details>


### [88] [Feedforward Novel View Synthesis for Heterogeneous Cameras](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03522)
*Meng Wei,Cheng Zhang,Boying Li,Yihang Chen,Jianmin Zheng,Hamid Rezatofighi,Jianfei Cai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 针对多传感器异构相机（透视/鱼眼/全景）下的前馈新视角合成，本文指出tokenization引入的投影依赖歧义，提出token中心相对相机位置编码、局部raymaps与投影感知2D RoPE，将异构相机视为共享光线空间的标定采样，在ScanNet++混合相机评测与全景零样本泛化上优于相机条件基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多数前馈NVS方法假设上下文视图与目标视图属于同一相机族（同质相机假设），但实际多传感器系统中透视、鱼眼、全景相机可能共存，且目标投影在训练时可能未见过，该假设失效。进一步识别出tokenization带来的关键歧义：视觉token聚合的是投影相关的一束像素光线，而现有相机编码主要暴露绝对光线或token中心关系，无法刻画patch内光线分布。

Method: 提出三个组件：1）token中心相对相机位置编码（relative Camera Positional Encodings），提供token中心间的相对关系；2）局部raymaps，一种token级表示，显式描述每个token所汇总的patch内光线分布；3）投影感知2D RoPE，用光线诱导的角度坐标替代原始图像网格坐标，使相对位置推理在不同相机投影间对齐。整体将多样相机视为共享光线空间的标定采样而非独立视觉域。

Result: 在具有异构相机系统的ScanNet++数据集上，混合相机评测中优于相机条件基线，并展现出对全景视图的零样本泛化能力。

Conclusion: 通过显式建模token级光线分布并统一相对位置推理，可将异构中心相机统一到共享光线空间，缓解同质相机假设带来的限制，实现跨投影的前馈新视角合成与全景零样本泛化。

Abstract: Feed-forward novel view synthesis has recently shown promising results from sparse posed images, but most existing methods assume that context and target views share a fixed camera family. This homogeneous-camera assumption breaks in practical multi-sensor systems, where perspective, fisheye, and panoramic cameras may coexist and where the target projection may be unseen during training. We study feed-forward NVS across heterogeneous central cameras and identify a key ambiguity introduced by tokenization: a visual token aggregates a projection-dependent bundle of pixel rays, while existing camera encodings mainly expose absolute rays or token-center relations. To address this, we combine token-center relative Camera Positional Encodings and proposed local raymaps, a token-level representation that explicitly describes the intra-patch ray distribution summarized by each token. We further propose projection-aware 2D RoPE, which replaces raw image-grid coordinates with ray-induced angular coordinates so that relative positional reasoning is aligned across camera projections. Together, these components treat diverse cameras as calibrated samplings of a shared ray space rather than separate visual domains. On ScanNet++ with heterogeneous-camera system, our method improves over camera-conditioned baselines under mixed-camera evaluation and demonstrates zero-shot generalization to panoramic views.

</details>


### [89] [DuoMatching: Joint-Marginal Distribution Matching for Few-Step Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03543)
*Jiahao Zhan,Yan Wang,Yongrui Ma,Qunliang Xing,Ruchang Yao,Runtao Liu,Shijie Zhao,Tianfan Xue*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出DuoMatching分布匹配框架，通过联合-边际统一建模提升流式视频生成的视觉质量与语义对齐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有DMD方法仅做视频帧联合分布匹配，虽能缓解自回归展开中的漂移，但在视觉质量和语义对齐上仍存在不足。

Method: 在联合匹配基础上引入边际匹配目标，利用图像生成器提供帧级监督以迁移互补的视觉与语义先验；设计LatentBridge解决视频学生模型与图像教师模型间的潜表示不匹配；并用Latent Variation Sampling将帧级监督分散到不同时间段以减少冗余。

Result: 实验表明该方法提升了视觉质量、构图与语义对齐，并较大程度保留运动动态；人类评估中对所有基线整体偏好率超过80%。

Conclusion: DuoMatching通过联合-边际统一分布匹配有效改善流式视频生成，兼顾运动动态与感知质量。

Abstract: Streaming video generation has benefited from distribution matching distillation (DMD), which matches the joint distribution of video frames to a video teacher's approximation of the real video distribution. Although this joint matching mitigates drift during autoregressive rollouts, limitations remain in visual quality and semantic alignment. To address these limitations, we propose DuoMatching, a distribution matching framework that approximates the real video distribution through a unified joint-marginal formulation. On top of existing joint matching formulations, the additional marginal matching objective provides dedicated frame-level supervision from an image generator, transferring complementary visual and semantic priors from it. To apply this frame-level supervision in video generation, we introduce LatentBridge to resolve the latent representation mismatch between the video student and the image teacher. Latent Variation Sampling further distributes such frame-level supervision across distinct temporal segments, reducing redundancy. Experiments demonstrate that DuoMatching improves visual quality, composition, and semantic alignment while largely preserving motion dynamics. Human evaluations show overall preference rates above 80% against all evaluated baselines. The project page is available at https://johnzhan2023.github.io/DuoMatching/.

</details>


### [90] [Rethinking What to Cache in Few-Step Diffusion Transformers: Solver-Aware Target Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03577)
*Shuo Yang,Lihao Fang,Yi Zhang,Haixiang Wang,Xincheng Ye,Shufan Chen,Jipeng Guo,Youqing Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 AutoTarget，在蒸馏后的 DiT 采样中自动选择缓存张量以降低误差、减少评估与缓存存储，同时保持生成质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DiT 生成需多次昂贵的前向传播；步蒸馏与缓存是两类加速手段，但蒸馏后相邻采样步间隔变大，跨步复用张量会引入更大误差，故"缓存什么张量"成为关键，而多数缓存方法预先固定复用目标，缺乏针对模型/求解器/复用调度的选择依据。

Method: AutoTarget：针对给定模型、求解器与复用调度，先用少量无缓存复用的运行测量复用每个候选张量所导致的误差，再选择误差最低的候选。同时分析单步复用误差对最终样本的影响；对 Euler 采样识别出能产生相同轨迹的缓存目标，并解释为何存储的求解器更新量未必等效。

Result: 在蒸馏的图像与视频 DiT 上，最优缓存目标随模型、图像分辨率和求解器变化。AutoTarget 减少了 DiT 评估次数与保留的缓存存储，生成质量接近对应的无缓存运行；在 PixArt-LCM 与 FLUX.1-schnell 设置上，其校准排序与留出缓存运行的排序一致。

Conclusion: 缓存目标的选择应由模型、求解器与复用调度共同决定而非预先固定；基于少量无缓存运行的误差校准可有效选出最优目标，兼顾加速与质量，核心实现已开源便于复现。

Abstract: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) can generate high-quality images and videos, but generating each sample requires multiple costly DiT forward passes. Two common ways to accelerate DiT sampling are step distillation, which reduces the number of sampling steps, and caching, which skips some DiT evaluations by reusing a tensor computed at an earlier step. Most caching methods decide in advance which tensor to reuse. After distillation, adjacent sampling steps are farther apart. Reusing a tensor across this larger gap introduces more error, so choosing what to cache becomes especially important. We therefore introduce AutoTarget, a method that chooses the cached tensor for a given model, solver, and reuse schedule. AutoTarget uses a small set of runs without cache reuse to measure the error caused by reusing each candidate tensor, then selects the candidate with the lowest error. We also analyze how an error at one reuse step affects the final sample. For Euler sampling, we identify cache targets that produce the same trajectory and show why a stored solver update may not. Experiments on distilled image and video DiTs show that the best cache target changes with the model, image resolution, and solver. AutoTarget reduces DiT evaluations and retained cache storage. Generation quality remains close to the corresponding uncached run. On the tested PixArt-LCM and FLUX.1-schnell settings, its calibration ranking matches the ranking from held-out cached runs. To help others reproduce the method, we provide its core implementation on GitHub at https://github.com/wali1024-offical/AutoTarget.

</details>


### [91] [ManifoldSplat: Language-Guided Semantic Shape Editing of 3D Gaussian Head Avatars](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03599)
*Antonio Canela,Jordi Sànchez-Riera*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ManifoldSplat是首个端到端语言引导的语义形状编辑框架，可在FLAME流形内对单目视频重建的可动画3D高斯化身进行局部化编辑，约90秒完成重建与编辑，渲染约800 FPS。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文本驱动3D头部化身编辑方法难以实现细粒度局部控制，特征纠缠、缺乏几何一致性，且修改几何往往需要缓慢的逐提示优化，或牺牲身份与绑定（rigging）。

Method: 在结构化FLAME流形内执行编辑，而非直接优化非结构化高斯点云，从而严格保持身份与动画；提出DeltaRegion——按区域解耦的条件变分自编码器（CVAE），提供前馈式形状增量（shape deltas），并辅以精化阶段恢复视角一致的细节。

Result: 在消费级GPU上约90秒完成化身重建与编辑，渲染约800 FPS；大量评估表明在局部提示对齐、几何一致性与身份保持方面达到新SOTA。

Conclusion: 通过将语言引导编辑约束在FLAME流形并采用区域解耦的前馈CVAE，ManifoldSplat实现了快速、局部可控且身份一致的3DGS头部化身语义形状编辑。

Abstract: High-fidelity 3D head avatars have reached near-photorealistic quality. While recent methods enable text-driven manipulation, they struggle to provide fine-grained localized control, often entangling features or lacking geometric consistency. Modifying geometry through natural language currently requires slow per-prompt optimization or compromises identity and rigging. We present ManifoldSplat, the first end-toend framework for language-guided semantic shape editing of animatable 3D Gaussian Splatting avatars reconstructed from monocular videos. By performing edits within the structured FLAME manifold rather than directly optimizing an unstructured Gaussian cloud, we strictly preserve identity and animation. We introduce DeltaRegion, a per-region disentangled Conditional Variational Autoencoder (CVAE) delivering feedforward shape deltas, alongside a refining stage to recover view-consistent details. ManifoldSplat reconstructs and edits an avatar in ~90 seconds on a consumer GPU, rendering at ~800 FPS. Extensive evaluations demonstrate our approach sets a new state-of-the-art in localized prompt alignment, geometric coherence, and identity preservation. Project page and code: https://a-canela.github.io/manifoldsplat/

</details>


### [92] [DEPICT: Scoring Text-to-Image Alignment by Answer Agreement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03617)
*Vasco Ramos,Sandra Godinho Silva,Joao Magalhaes,Ricardo Rei,Pedro Henrique Martins*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出无训练指标DEPICT，用图像与纯文本答案的期望一致性替代固定参考答案，并融合整体分数，在五个基准、十一个骨架上超越所有免训练指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图像-文本对齐评测需求日益严苛，需发现缺失对象、属性错位、计数错误、忽视否定等问题；现有微调指标受限于单一骨架与训练分布，整体式指标丢失细粒度细节，分解式指标依赖固定"是"的假设，导致忠实图像被误罚。

Method: DEPICT为免训练指标：将分解式验证问题中的固定参考答案替换为图像答案与纯文本答案之间的期望一致性，并按文本对问题的决定程度对问题加权；再将该一致性分数与整体式分数融合，以恢复分解过程丢失的上下文。

Result: 替换固定参考后，否定准确率由19%提升至88%；在五个基准、来自三个模型家族的十一个骨架上评估，DEPICT超过所有免训练指标，并在三个人工相关性基准中的两个上超过微调评测器。

Conclusion: 以期望一致性替代固定参考、并结合整体分数，是构建免训练、可迁移且细粒度可靠的图文对齐评测指标的有效路径。

Abstract: Image-text alignment is a core problem in computer vision with applications in caption evaluation, hallucination detection, data curation, and the benchmarking of text-to-image (T2I) generators. As T2I models improve, benchmarking has become demanding, requiring metrics capable of finding a series of issues like missing objects, swapped attributes, miscounts, and ignored negations. Recent work addresses this by fine-tuning evaluators on preference data or by prompting a vision-language model, either holistically with the caption or with decomposed verification questions. However, existing approaches fall short: fine-tuned metrics remain bound to one backbone and training distribution; holistic metrics miss fine-grained details; and decomposed metrics rely on a fixed-YES assumption that penalizes faithful images whenever that assumption fails. In contrast, we propose DEPICT, a training-free metric that replaces fixed reference answers with expected agreement between image-based and caption-only answers, weighting questions by how decisively the caption determines them. By replacing fixed references, our agreement rule increases negation accuracy from 19% to 88%. To recover the context lost during decomposition, DEPICT merges this agreement score with a holistic score. We evaluate DEPICT on five benchmarks and eleven backbones from three model families and find that it surpasses all training-free metrics and exceeds fine-tuned evaluators on two out of three human-correlation benchmarks.

</details>


### [93] [World Embedding Benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03632)
*Yiqi Liu,Ruifeng Yuan,Yang Wang,Long Li,Fengyu Cai,Hou Pong Chan,Jialin Yu,Hao Zhang,Chenghua Lin,Chenghao Xiao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出World Embedding Benchmark（8,000个受控仿真案例，涵盖80个族、四个物理领域），通过检索、物理属性回归、描述配对分类三项任务，联合评估视频表征的物理对齐性与物理信息可恢复性，并证明物理表征可用于检索增强生成以提升视频生成的物理保真度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 世界模型与视频生成中的"物理保真度"日益受关注，但视频表征如何编码物理信息尚不清楚；且已有评测往往混淆"跨模态物理对齐"与"定量物理信息可恢复性"这两个不同维度，缺乏受控、带物理标注的评测基准。

Method: 构建World Embedding Benchmark：8,000个受控仿真案例，来自80个族，覆盖流体力学、固体力学、动力学、光学与电磁学；每个案例包含渲染视频与仿真导出的物理标注。设计三项互补任务：文本-视频检索、物理属性回归、视频-描述对的单选分类。评测预训练全模态嵌入模型，并使用轻量探针（probes）从冻结视频嵌入中提取物理信息；进一步采用物理专用视频-文本对做持续对比训练；最后用嵌入检索参考视频，进行基于检索的生成（RAG with MiniMax-H3）。

Result: 预训练全模态嵌入模型检索性能弱，族内配对分类接近随机；轻量探针可从冻结视频嵌入中恢复有用物理信息。物理专用对比持续训练提升了检索与配对分类，但使物理属性回归性能下降，揭示对齐性与定量信息可恢复性之间的权衡。检索到的参考视频提升了MiniMax-H3生成视频的物理保真度，且检索模型越强，增益越大。

Conclusion: 应联合评估物理对齐性与物理属性可恢复性，而非仅看单一指标；物理表征对提升视频生成的物理保真度具有实用价值，检索增强生成是一条有效路径。

Abstract: Physical fidelity has received increasing attention in world models and video generation, yet how video representations encode physical information remains less understood. We introduce the World Embedding Benchmark, comprising 8,000 controlled simulation cases from 80 families spanning fluid mechanics, solid mechanics, dynamics, and optics & electromagnetism. Each case pairs a rendered video with simulation-derived physical annotations, supporting three complementary tasks: text-video retrieval, physical-property regression, and multiple-choice video-description pair classification. We use these tasks to distinguish cross-modal physical alignment from the recoverability of quantitative physical information. Evaluated pre-trained omnimodal embedding models show weak retrieval and near-chance within-family pair classification, while lightweight probes recover useful physical information from frozen video embeddings. Continual contrastive training with physics-specific video-text pairs improves retrieval and pair classification but degrades physical-property regression, revealing a trade-off between alignment and quantitative information recoverability. Finally, we use the embeddings to retrieve reference videos for retrieval-augmented generation with MiniMax-H3. Retrieved references improve the physical fidelity of generated videos, with stronger retrieval models yielding larger gains in our experiments. Together, these findings highlight the need to evaluate physical alignment and property recoverability jointly, and demonstrate the utility of physical representations for improving video generation.

</details>


### [94] [LoGo: Local-Global Rewards for Consistent Long-Horizon Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03636)
*Ziqi Ma,Shreya Sharma,Mohamed El Banani,Katja Schwarz,Chongjie Ye,Chao-Yuan Wu,Li Fei-Fei,Ben Mildenhall,Georgia Gkioxari,Justin Johnson,Gowthami Somepalli*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LoGo：通过融合全局与空间局部奖励的细粒度信用分配，提升相机控制视频模型的3D一致性，同时保持相机跟随与视频质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 相机控制视频生成正向长时序、复杂运镜发展，但存在3D不一致问题：相机移动时物体失去持久性、场景结构发生漂移。现有后训练方法对整个生成结果只赋予单一标量奖励，无法在长时序上定位并纠正这些不一致，即信用分配过于粗糙。

Method: 提出LoGo，将全局奖励与空间局部奖励相融合用于相机控制视频模型的后训练。局部奖励提供细粒度信用分配以改善3D一致性，全局奖励维持相机跟随能力和视频质量。同时在DL3DV与新建的TrajectoryBench（面向长时序复杂相机控制生成）上，跨三个基础模型进行验证。

Result: 在三个基础模型上，LoGo在DL3DV和TrajectoryBench上均表现出明显优势；有效减少局部物体漂移、伪影和全局场景变化。

Conclusion: 细粒度信用分配对视频模型后训练至关重要，LoGo通过全局+局部奖励的融合为长时序、复杂相机控制生成提供了有效方案，并指出当前评测在长时序复杂运镜方面的缺失。

Abstract: Camera-controlled video models are rapidly advancing toward long generation horizons and complex camera control. A key failure mode is 3D inconsistency: as the camera moves, objects lose permanence and scene structures shift. Existing post-training techniques, which assign a single scalar reward to the entire generation, are poorly suited to correcting these inconsistencies over long horizons. We introduce LoGo, which blends global and spatially localized rewards for camera-controlled video models. The local reward provides fine-grained credit assignment, which substantially improves 3D consistency, while the global reward preserves camera following and video quality. Across three base models, LoGo shows a clear advantage on DL3DV and TrajectoryBench, a new benchmark for long-horizon, complex-camera-control generation that current evaluations lack. LoGo effectively reduces local object shifts, artifacts, and global scene changes, illustrating the importance of credit assignment in post-training video models. Project website: https://ziqi-ma.github.io/logo-website/

</details>


### [95] [On-Board Anomaly Detection for Efficient Marine Environmental Monitoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03649)
*Thomas Goudemant,Clotilde Szywala,Benjamin Francesconi,Michelle Aubrun,Yves Bobichon,Marjorie Bellizzi,Adrien Girard*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种面向多/高光谱卫星的在轨海洋事件检测流水线，结合自监督编码器压缩图像与机器学习异常检测模型识别海洋环境异常，兼顾轻量部署与带宽优化，并已在ESA Phisat-2与IMAGIN-e任务中集成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 海洋生态系统受溢油、藻华、泥沙泛滥等威胁，破坏栖息地、野生动物与人类活动。卫星遥感与AI的进步提升了早期检测与减灾能力，但星上计算资源受限、通信带宽有限，亟需高效的在轨处理方案。

Method: 构建面向多/高光谱地球观测卫星的海洋事件检测流水线：1）自监督神经网络编码器将卫星图像压缩到低维潜在空间，实现高效在轨处理；2）机器学习异常检测模型识别偏离正常海洋模式的异常；3）与Isolation Forest、One-Class SVM、Local Outlier Factor等传统算法对比；4）流水线轻量、资源高效，适配从嵌入式CPU到AI硬件加速器的星载平台；5）优先传输关键信息。

Result: 流水线在提升系统响应性的同时优化了卫星通信带宽；通过与Isolation Forest、One-Class SVM、LOF等传统算法的性能对比验证其异常检测能力；并已在ESA Phisat-2与Microsoft/Thales Alenia Space IMAGIN-e等多个任务中实现集成。

Conclusion: 该轻量级在轨流水线可提供及时告警与高效数据压缩，从而改善海洋环境监测，并具备跨任务部署与推广的可行性。

Abstract: Marine ecosystems are impacted by various threats such as oil spills, algal blooms, and sediment floods, which disrupt habitats, wildlife, and human activities. Advances in satellite imagery and Artificial Intelligence (AI) have enhanced our capabilities for early detection and mitigation of such hazards. In this paper, we propose a marine event detection pipeline for Earth observation satellites equipped with multi- or hyperspectral sensors. Our approach includes a self-supervised neural network encoder that compresses satellite images into a reduced latent space, enabling efficient onboard processing. A machine learning anomaly detection model identifies deviations from normal sea patterns to detect environmental anomalies. We compare its performance against traditional algorithms such as Isolation Forest, One-Class Support Vector Machine and Local Outlier Factors. Our lightweight, resource-efficient pipeline is optimized for deployment on satellites with limited computational resources, ranging from embedded CPUs to AI hardware accelerators. By prioritizing the transmission of critical information, our solution enhances system responsiveness and optimizes satellite communication bandwidth. Demonstrated through current integration across multiple missions, including European Space Agency's (ESA) Phisat-2 mission and Microsoft/Thales Alenia Space IMAGIN-e mission, our pipeline aims to improve marine environmental monitoring by providing timely alerts and efficient data reduction.

</details>


### [96] [ProAR: Learning Prospective Reasoning with Autoregressive Video Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03664)
*Linghui Shen,Tinghui Zhu,Sheng Zhang,Muhao Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 ProAR 框架，将自回归视频生成从"短视反应式"预测转化为目标导向的推理过程，通过目标帧预测与未来表征自对齐两种机制，在低训练成本下提升视觉推理性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归视频模型擅长因果生成，但依赖"下一块预测"（next-chunk prediction）导致其局限于短视、反应式的范式。对于以推理为导向的生成任务，关键在于通过有效的中间状态达成目标结果，而非局部视觉合理性，现有范式难以满足这一需求。

Method: ProAR 包含两个核心组件：(1) 目标帧预测——通过非对称注意力掩码（asymmetric attention mask）将目标帧预测融入自回归循环，使预测的目标帧引导中间状态生成，同时不被中间状态干扰，从而锚定长程结果；(2) 未来表征自对齐——鼓励当前隐状态预判即将到来的时序动态，利用 AR 训练中的 teacher-forcing 在单次前向传播中提取干净的未来表征，并通过轻量级、仅训练时使用的预测器（predictor）对齐当前表征。两者结合，将显式的稀疏目标监督与隐式的密集逐步引导相融合。

Result: 实验表明，ProAR 的两个互补组件在多种视觉推理基准上持续提升性能；框架训练效率高，仅用 25% 的训练步数即超越完全训练的标准 AR 基线，并在具身推理任务上展现出良好的适用性。

Conclusion: ProAR 通过显式稀疏目标监督与隐式密集逐步引导的结合，实现了连贯、目标导向的推理过程，且计算开销适中，为自回归视频模型在推理导向及具身推理任务中的应用提供了有效范式。

Abstract: Autoregressive (AR) video models excel at causal generation, but their reliance on next-chunk prediction confines them to a short-sighted, reactive paradigm. This limitation is particularly consequential for reasoning-oriented generation, where achieving a target outcome through valid intermediate states matters more than local visual plausibility. To address this challenge, we propose Learning Prospective Reasoning with Autoregressive Video Models (ProAR), a novel framework that transforms autoregressive video generation into a goal-oriented reasoning process. ProAR introduces two key components: (1) To anchor generation to the long-range outcome, we integrate goal-frame prediction into the autoregressive loop via an asymmetric attention mask, enabling the predicted goal frame to guide the generation of intermediate states without being disrupted by them. (2) To guide short-range transitions, we introduce future representation self-alignment to encourage current hidden states to anticipate upcoming temporal dynamics. By leveraging teacher-forcing in AR training, we extract clean future representations in a single forward pass and align current representations with them using a lightweight, training-only predictor. Together, these two mechanisms seamlessly combine explicit, sparse target supervision with implicit, dense step-wise guidance, promoting coherent, goal-directed reasoning progress with modest computational cost. Experiments show that ProAR's complementary components consistently improve performance across diverse visual reasoning benchmarks. The framework proves highly training-efficient, surpassing fully trained standard AR baselines using only 25% of the training steps. This paradigm also demonstrates promising applicability to embodied reasoning tasks.

</details>


### [97] [SigLIP2 for aerial fire risk classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03689)
*Yunus Serhat Bıçakçı*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 将预训练SigLIP2图像编码器迁移至基于航空影像的七类别火灾风险分类任务，比较冻结编码器探针与全模型微调两种方案，并公开可复现的数据划分与实验代码。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者希望检验预训练视觉编码器（SigLIP2）在航空影像火灾风险分类任务上的可迁移性，同时解决该领域缺乏可复现数据划分、数据溯源与模型选择规范的问题，为后续多编码器对比提供统一框架。

Method: 对公开FireRisk训练镜像进行可复现的重新划分，并实现一套记录数据溯源、预处理流程与模型选择过程的实验框架；开展两组初始实验，分别采用冻结编码器线性探针与全模型适配，两者均使用单一训练随机种子，并在同一验证划分上选择检查点。

Result: 在验证集上，全模型适配达到63.05%准确率与58.94%宏F1，冻结探针为55.95%准确率与50.19%宏F1，全适配在两项指标上均明显更优。

Conclusion: 初步结果表明SigLIP2值得进一步评估，但当前结果仅为开发阶段结论，尚不能说明其在独立测试集或未见区域上的性能；配套代码为重复实验及与更多视觉编码器的比较提供了通用框架。

Abstract: We examine the transfer of a pretrained SigLIP2 image encoder to seven class fire risk classification from aerial imagery. We introduce a reproducible partition of the public FireRisk training mirror and an implementation that records data provenance, preprocessing and model selection. Two initial runs compare a frozen encoder probe with full model adaptation. On the validation partition, full adaptation reaches 63.05% accuracy and 58.94% macro F1, compared with 55.95% and 50.19% for the probe. Both runs use one training seed and select their checkpoint on the same validation partition. These development results support further evaluation of SigLIP2 but do not establish performance on an independent test set or unseen regions. The accompanying code provides a common framework for repeated experiments and comparisons with additional visual encoders.

</details>


### [98] [FlowHMR: Physically Plausible Motion Capture from Video](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03691)
*Zhanke Wang,Chengfeng Zhao,Qing Shuai,Jingzhong Lin,Heng Li,Zeyu Ling,Yuxin Wen,Jing Li,Di Kang,Chunchao Guo,Linchao Bao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FlowHMR将单目视频人体运动捕捉重构为"视频条件运动生成"问题，先用流匹配模型预训练生成多样候选，再用GRPO结合保真度与可跟踪性双奖励后训练，从而在保持视频保真度的同时提升物理合理性，并发布约4K视频的Wild-4K数据集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从单目视频恢复全局3D人体运动存在深度固有的歧义性，直接回归容易坍缩到平均解；且恢复的运动不保证物理合理，导致基于物理的跟踪经常失败。

Method: 将视频运动捕捉表述为视频条件运动生成任务，先预训练一个流匹配模型；给定视频生成多样运动候选后，使用GRPO进行后训练，并设计两个奖励：保真度奖励（约束与输入视频一致）与跟踪奖励（偏好物理控制器可成功跟踪的运动），共同调整模型输出偏好。

Result: 在自建的Wild-4K数据集（约4K互联网视频）上进行定性与定量实验，方法在整体运动保真度上优于现有最先进方法，物理跟踪成功率达82.47%，而最强基线GVHMR为62.82%。

Conclusion: 以生成式建模结合强化学习后训练的方式，可在保持视频保真度的同时显著提升单目人体运动恢复的物理合理性与可跟踪性，Wild-4K为野外场景评测提供了新的基准。

Abstract: We present FlowHMR, a framework for recovering physically plausible global 3D human motion from monocular video. Previous learning-based methods typically regress human motion directly from video and train the network with geometric supervision. However, recovering human motion from monocular video is inherently ambiguous in depth, and direct regression tends to collapse toward an averaged solution.
