Method: RRDF采用"隔离—收集—路由"（isolate-collect-route）调度：早期保持视觉与紧凑流分离的前缀，屏蔽直接的紧凑-视觉注意；后期仅允许经可学习register工作区的中介式交换；同时紧凑条件仍可直接供给原生动作生成器。并在5个仿真任务和3个真机任务上评估，含外观漂移与留出位置测试、相位匹配输入探针与消融实验。

Result: 在5个仿真任务和3个真机任务上，RRDF在标称条件下匹配或优于密集ACT；4个仿真任务的外观漂移评估和3个真机任务的留出位置评估也偏好RRDF；相位匹配输入探针显示更低的state-to-image敏感度；消融表明仅加入register并不能复现完整性能增益。

Conclusion: 控制跨模态传播路径（延迟并经register中介的融合），同时保留紧凑动作条件，可有效提升视觉运动模仿策略的视觉响应性与鲁棒性。

Abstract: Visuomotor imitation policies combine high-dimensional visual observations with compact signals such as proprioception, and their fusion topology determines when and through which tokens these streams interact. In dense token fusion, visual tokens may attend directly to compact tokens from the first encoder layer, allowing action-predictive compact cues to influence spatial visual representations early in their formation. We ask whether controlling this route improves visual responsiveness and policy behavior. We introduce Register-Routed Delayed Fusion (RRDF), which masks direct compact-visual attention and stages cross-modal interaction through a learned register workspace. Its isolate-collect-route schedule protects an early stream-separated prefix and later permits only register-mediated exchange, while compact conditioning remains available to the native action generator. Across five simulation tasks and three real-robot tasks, RRDF matches or improves dense ACT under nominal conditions. Appearance-shift evaluations on four simulation tasks and held-out-position evaluations on three real-robot tasks also favor RRDF. Phase-matched input probes show lower measured state-to-image sensitivity, while ablations indicate that adding registers alone does not reproduce the full performance gain. These results support controlling cross-modal propagation while retaining compact action conditioning.

</details>


### [133] [FastOPD: On-Policy Distillation for Lightweight VLA Deployment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02832)
*Yoojin Oh,Jeongsol Kim,Yeonwoo Seo,Jangho Park,Seonghyun Jin,Sunwoo Park,Youngmin Kim,Youngjun Jun,Kyumin Choi,Jong Chul Ye*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: FastOPD 是一个"基础模型到轻量模型"的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）框架，通过高效的同策略（on-policy）蒸馏，将大规模 VLA 教师压缩为紧凑学生模型，显著降低推理延迟并保持较高性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA 基础模型规模快速扩张以提升操作性能与泛化能力，但带来高计算成本，使真实部署愈发困难。已有方案多为设计更小架构或减少基于流（flow-based）策略的迭代去噪步数，存在性能与效率权衡问题。

Method: 提出 FastOPD：适配 flow map 以进行单状态（single-state）教师监督，并结合自一致性（self-consistency）目标，构建学习教师动力学的紧凑学生模型；同时从理论上证明最小化该目标可使蒸馏学生恢复到与理想少步教师模型相当的分布。

Result: 在 LIBERO 上，FastOPD 仅用两步推理即保留 π_{0.5} 84% 的性能，推理延迟降低 78.1%，平均成功率优于现有少步蒸馏基线；以 LingBot-VLA 为教师时，在 RoboTwin 2.0 上单步成功率较基础学生提升 15.9 个百分点；并验证了其对 World Action Model（WAM）的适用性，以及在真实机器人上部署由 MolmoAct2 蒸馏的紧凑学生模型。

Conclusion: FastOPD 通过 on-policy 蒸馏与自一致性目标，为大规模 VLA 的实用化部署提供了有效路径，在少步推理条件下实现性能与效率的良好平衡，并具备跨模型、跨任务（仿真与真实机器人）的通用性。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) foundation models have scaled rapidly to enhance manipulation performance and generalizability, but this scaling incurs high computational costs that render real-world deployment increasingly challenging. Existing approaches typically mitigate this issue by designing smaller architectures or reducing the iterative denoising steps in flow-based policies. In this work, we propose FastOPD, a foundation-to-lightweight VLA framework that enables the practical deployment of large-scale VLAs through efficient on-policy distillation. Specifically, FastOPD adapts a flow map for single-state teacher supervision and combines it with a self-consistency objective to construct a compact student that learns the teacher dynamics. Furthermore, we theoretically demonstrate that minimizing this objective allows the distilled student to recover a distribution on par with that induced by an ideal few-step teacher model. We evaluate FastOPD across diverse foundation policies in simulation and real-world experiments. On LIBERO, FastOPD retains 84% of the performance of $π_{0.5}$ with only two inference steps, reducing inference latency by 78.1% while outperforming existing few-step distillation baselines in average success rate. With LingBot-VLA as the teacher, FastOPD improves the single-step success rate over the base student by 15.9 percentage points on RoboTwin 2.0. We further demonstrate its applicability to a World Action Model (WAM) and deploy a compact student distilled from MolmoAct2 on a real robot.

</details>


### [134] [PointWAM: 3D World Action Modeling for Dexterous Robotic Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02840)
*Chunghyun Park,Beomjun Kim,Seungcheol Park,Heeseung Kwon,Yashu Shukla,Seunghoon Sim,Jinwoo Shin,Minsu Cho*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: PointWAM 是一种 3D 世界动作模型，将世界分解为场景与手部，并在统一时空坐标系中联合预测两者的 3D 点轨迹，从而提升灵巧操作性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有世界动作模型多以 RGB 帧或隐空间表示世界，并以末端位姿或关节角表示动作，难以捕捉灵巧操作所关键的 3D 空间结构与接触几何。

Method: 将世界分解为场景（环境）与手部（执行者），在共享的时空坐标系中以 3D 点轨迹形式联合预测二者的协同演化；基于彩色点云与语言指令进行预测，并将预测的手部运动重定向为机器人动作。该显式解耦表示支持在无需任务特定物体或关键点标注的大规模人类演示视频上预训练。

Result: 在人类视频上预训练使 DexJoCo 平均成功率提升 56.9 个百分点；场景轨迹监督在仅预测手部的基础上再提升 10.9 个百分点。二者结合后，在十个 DexJoCo 任务上较此前最优方法高出 11.7 个百分点，并在真实机器人上优于强 VLA 模型。

Conclusion: 以场景—手部解耦的 3D 点轨迹作为世界动作表示，可有效利用人类视频预训练并显著提升灵巧操作的任务成功率与真实机器人表现。

Abstract: World action models jointly learn to forecast world dynamics and predict robot actions, such that the learned internal world dynamics guide accurate actions. Existing approaches typically represent the world as RGB frames or latent counterparts while predicting actions as end-effector poses or joint angles, but they often struggle to capture the 3D spatial structure and contact geometry central to dexterous manipulation. We introduce Point World Action Model (PointWAM), a 3D world action model that decomposes the world into a scene (i.e., environment) and hands (i.e., actor), and jointly forecasts both as 3D point trajectories within a shared space-time coordinate frame. This explicit, disentangled representation enables effective pre-training on large-scale human demonstration videos without requiring any task-specific object or keypoint selection. Given a colored point cloud and a language instruction, PointWAM predicts how the scene and hands co-evolve in 3D space over time, then retargets the forecast hand motion to robot actions. Pre-training on human videos improves average DexJoCo success by 56.9 percentage points, and scene-trajectory supervision adds 10.9 points over forecasting the hands alone. With both, PointWAM surpasses the prior state of the art on ten DexJoCo tasks by 11.7 points and outperforms strong VLAs on a real robot.

</details>


### [135] [Permutation Robustness Is Not Enough: Action Collapse in Multi-Agent Transformer Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02848)
*Amit Thakur,Mukesh Singhal*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 多智能体Transformer策略存在顺序敏感性问题，且低置换误差指标具有误导性；需结合动作塌缩诊断评估，弱等变性正则可提升N=3团队鲁棒性并保持动作多样性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer策略因自注意力可建模智能体间交互而适用于多智能体机器人学习，但多智能体团队本质上是无序集合，而Transformer通常将智能体作为有序token序列处理。论文研究这一不匹配如何在智能体顺序置换下影响协作导航策略，并指出仅用低置换误差评估稳健性可能产生误导。

Method: 在不同智能体顺序置换条件下评估协作导航策略，同时使用置换一致性指标与动作塌缩诊断指标（动作多样性、同动作比例、最大动作频率）。对比PPO-ID基线、强等变性正则化与弱等变性惩罚，并在N=3和N=4智能体团队中测试不同正则化权重的影响。

Result: PPO-ID基线表现出非塌缩行为但依然对顺序敏感；强等变性正则化仍可能诱发同质化行为；弱等变性惩罚在N=3团队中提升鲁棒性并保留更多样的动作，而N=4团队需要显著更小的正则化权重。

Conclusion: 多智能体Transformer策略的评估不应仅依赖回报和置换鲁棒性，还应考察其是否维持非塌缩、差异化的多智能体行为。

Abstract: Transformer policies are attractive for multi-agent robot learning because self-attention can model interactions among agents. However, multi-agent teams are unordered, while transformers typically process agents as ordered token sequences. We study how this mismatch affects cooperative navigation policies under agent-order permutations. Our results show that low permutation error alone can be misleading: policies may appear robust simply because all agents choose the same action. We therefore evaluate policies using both permutation-consistency metrics and action-collapse diagnostics, including action diversity, same-action fraction, and maximum action frequency. A PPO-ID baseline yields non-collapsed behavior but remains order-sensitive, while strong equivariance regularization can still induce homogeneous behavior. A weak equivariance penalty improves the robustness while preserving more diverse actions for teams with \(N=3\) agents, whereas teams with \(N=4\) agents require substantially smaller regularization weights. These findings suggest that multi-agent transformer policies should be evaluated not only by return and permutation robustness, but also by whether they maintain non-collapsed, differentiated multi-agent behavior.

</details>


### [136] [SceneFactory-3D: Lifting 2D Traffic Scenes into 3D Physical Counterfactuals for Scalable Physically Grounded Safety Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02874)
*Yicheng Zhu,Linfeng Tian,Tianmu Zhao,Yang Chen,Fan Zuo,Tao Li,Zilin Bian*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出GPU批处理、物理驱动的多智能体驾驶仿真器SceneFactory-3D，通过逐轮接触点的悬架与摩擦受限力执行车辆指令，支持并行反事实评估，并实证揭示学习型控制器对路面条件的显著敏感性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可扩展驾驶仿真器通常用预设行为或运动学规则执行车辆指令，忽略轮胎-路面接触物理，难以刻画恶劣道路与环境条件如何改变车辆执行并传播至交通流。

Method: SceneFactory-3D采用GPU批处理与逐世界地形隔离，在每个轮-地接触点依据悬架和摩擦受限力执行加速度和转向指令；空间变化的摩擦系数、逐世界3D高度场、重力与刚体接触统一约束车轮运动与车身碰撞。固定交通场景与控制器，仅改变路面条件，实现并行匹配物理反事实评估。

Result: 在21种摩擦与坡度条件下，对1,024个匹配的12车世界评估三类学习策略，并在共享32世界子集上评估两种经典规划器。当摩擦从1.0降至0.18时，学习策略安全通过施工区的车辆比例下降6至90个百分点（经典规划器为18-19个百分点），且所有学习策略的近碰撞情形均更频繁。

Conclusion: 将轮胎-路面物理引入可扩展多智能体仿真，可支持并行匹配反事实评估，并为量化自主控制器对路面条件的敏感性提供系统化经验证据。

Abstract: Scalable driving simulators typically execute vehicle commands using prescribed behavioral or kinematic rules, overlooking the physics of tire-road interfaces, thereby limiting their ability to capture how adverse road and environmental conditions alter vehicle execution and propagate through traffic. To address this limitation, we present SceneFactory-3D, a GPU-batched, physics-grounded multi-agent driving simulator. Vehicles execute acceleration and steering commands via suspension- and friction-limited forces evaluated at each wheel-contact point. Spatially varying friction, per-world 3D heightfields, gravity, and rigid contact consistently govern wheel motion and chassis collisions. Per-world terrain isolation and GPU batching enable SceneFactory-3D to run matched physical counterfactuals in parallel: traffic scenario setup and vehicle controllers remain fixed while only the road condition changes, enabling the resulting closed-loop effects to be evaluated across parallel worlds. To demonstrate the advantage of the SceneFactory-3D-enabled counterfactual evaluation, we conduct an empirical study on vehicle controllers' sensitivity to road conditions. We study three learned-policy families on 1,024 matched 12-vehicle worlds per condition, and two classical planners on a shared 32-world subset, across 21 friction and grade conditions. When friction drops from 1.0 to 0.18, the share of vehicles that clear the work zone safely falls by 6 to 90 percentage points across learned policies (18-19 for classical planners), and near-collision situations become more frequent for every learned policy. Code: https://github.com/SmallWorldLab/SceneFactory_3D

</details>


### [137] [MixVLA: Adaptive Mixing of Non-Invariant Information for Generalizable Vision-Language-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02898)
*Pingrui Zhang,Yu Zhang,Pengyuan Wu,Bin Wang,Haoming Song,Xianqiang Gao,ZhaxiZhuoma,Zhigang Wang,Dong Wang,Bin Zhao,Xuelong Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出模型无关训练框架MixVLA，通过自适应混合非不变信息（AMI）来提升VLA模型在OOD条件下的零样本泛化能力，无需额外OOD数据或改架构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA模型虽在机器人操作上进展显著，但在分布外（OOD）条件下的零样本泛化仍受限。其根源在于模型将任务相关的不变结构与环境相关的非不变因素纠缠，导致策略在动作预测时依赖虚假的表观线索。

Method: 提出MixVLA，一种模型无关的训练框架，核心为自适应混合非不变信息（AMI）。AMI对非不变表示进行随机混合，以正则化分布特定的变异性，同时保留互补的预测线索；随后将混合后的非不变特征与不变表示融合，用于最终动作预测。

Result: 在LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus、RoboTwin扰动套件及真实世界任务等挑战性操作设置下进行大量实验，表明MixVLA在保持强域内性能的同时提升了整体零样本鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 通过解耦并混合非不变信息，MixVLA在不牺牲策略表达能力的前提下增强了VLA模型的OOD零样本泛化能力，且无需额外OOD数据与架构修改。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have achieved remarkable advances in robotic manipulation, yet their zero-shot generalization under out-of-distribution (OOD) conditions remains limited. These models often entangle task-relevant invariant structure with environment-specific non-invariant factors, causing policies to rely on spurious appearance cues during action prediction. In this work, we propose \textbf{MixVLA}, a model-agnostic training framework that improves the generalization of VLA models without requiring additional OOD data or architectural modifications. The key component of MixVLA is \textbf{Adaptive Mixing of Non-Invariant Information (AMI)}. AMI stochastically mixes non-invariant representations to regularize distribution-specific variability while preserving complementary predictive cues. The mixed non-invariant features are then fused with invariant representations for final action prediction, resulting in improved robustness without sacrificing policy expressiveness. Extensive experiments across challenging manipulation settings, including LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, the RoboTwin perturbation suite, and real-world tasks, demonstrate that MixVLA improves overall zero-shot robustness while retaining strong in-domain performance.

</details>


### [138] [From Language Priors to Field Adaptation: Preference Learning for Traversability Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02974)
*Simon Schwaiger,David Seyser,Alessandro Scherl,Zlatan Ajanović,Wilfried Wöber,Gerald Steinbauer-Wagner*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该工作用冯·米塞斯-费舍尔混合原型表示可通行性，结合自然语言常识先验与稀疏图像偏好标注，实现样本高效的目标域适配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于图像的可通行性估计高度依赖机器人平台、部署域和任务偏好，导致专用训练的模型泛化能力受限；本文旨在通过样本高效的偏好学习，减少目标域所需的标注数量以实现域适配。

Method: 将可通行性表示为冻结视觉-语言特征空间中的冯·米塞斯-费舍尔（vMF）混合原型；利用相对自然语言规则提供常识先验，并通过稀疏的相对图像标注，以计算与样本高效的方式进行微调，从而调整原型方向与效用值以适配目标域。

Result: 在 WayFAST 上的实验表明，其精度可与端到端训练的估计器相媲美，同时实现样本高效的图像域适配；定性实验验证了语言先验的零样本适用性以及微调后估计器在语义图上更优的稠密预测；并通过剖析语义相近的自然语言提示对所学原型进行语义解释。

Conclusion: 该方法通过原型化表示与语言先验结合稀疏相对偏好标注，可在少量标注下完成跨域可通行性估计适配，兼顾精度与样本效率，并提供可解释性；代码与训练好的估计器已公开。

Abstract: Image-based traversability estimation is inherently dependent on the robot platform, deployment domain, and mission preferences, which limits the applicability of purpose-trained models. To facilitate domain adaptation, this work aims to reduce the number of required annotations in the target domain using sample-efficient preference learning. Our method represents traversability through von Mises-Fisher mixture prototypes in a frozen vision-language feature space. Relative natural-language rules provide a commonsense prior, while sparse relative image annotations adapt the prototype directions and utilities to a target domain through computationally and sample-efficient fine-tuning. Experiments on WayFAST demonstrate accuracy competitive with end-to-end trained estimators while enabling sample-efficient image-based adaptation. Qualitative experiments further demonstrate the language prior's zero shot applicability and the fine-tuned estimator's improved dense prediction on semantic maps. Evaluation is complemented via semantic interpretation of learned prototypes by dissecting semantically close natural language prompts. Code and trained estimators available at https://resireg.github.io

</details>


### [139] [On Representational Alignment among Embodied Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02985)
*Fulvio Mastrogiovanni*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出"关系充分性"(relational sufficiency)框架,用以判定异构、异步且观察者相对的具身智能体表征在交互中哪些歧义必须被消除;并给出光滑系统下所需独立标量锚点的局部一阶下界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 具身智能体即便感知同一物理过程,其表征也可能异构、异步且依赖观察者。既有做法常默认这些表征需要全局对齐,但这一假设过强且未必必要。论文转而追问:为了达成连贯交互,表征之间究竟哪些差异必须被真正消除。

Method: 形式化引入"关系充分性":以交互特定的关系证据映射(relational-evidence map)刻画比较后仍未消除的表征歧义;当每条残余歧义纤维都落在某个交互等价类内时,充分性成立。若条件不满足,则需引入额外的感觉运动锚点(sensorimotor anchors),以精确分离那些会改变交互相关结果的歧义。针对光滑系统,推导出所需独立标量锚点数的局部一阶下界,其值等于"对关系证据不可见、但对交互相关映射可见"的方向维数。理论在共享相同观察者、表征、传输与关系证据的两种异步交接(hand-off)场景中实例化。

Result: 在两种异步交接变体中:相对同步(relative synchronization)无需额外锚点;而在绝对时间下进行交接则恰好需要1个锚点。二者共享全部观察者、表征、传输与关系证据,仅交互目标不同,所需锚点数目即产生差异。

Conclusion: 该分析为表征对齐提供了任务相对的停止条件:当残余分歧对交互而言是不变量时,无需将其完全消除。所需锚点数量由交互目标本身决定,而非由表征差异的绝对大小决定。

Abstract: Embodied agents interacting with the same physical process may maintain heterogeneous, asynchronous, and observer-relative representations. Rather than assuming that such representations should always be globally aligned, we investigate which distinctions among them must actually be resolved for coherent interaction. We formalize this question through relational sufficiency: an interaction-specific relational-evidence map defines the representational ambiguity left unresolved by comparison, and sufficiency holds when each residual ambiguity fiber lies within an interaction-equivalence class. When this condition fails, additional sensorimotor anchors must separate precisely the ambiguities that can change the interaction-relevant outcome. For smooth systems, we derive a local first-order lower bound on the number of inde- pendent scalar anchors required, given by the dimension of directions that are invisible to relational evidence but visible to the interaction-relevant map. We instantiate the theory in two variants of an asynchronous hand-off scenario that share the same observer agents, representations, transports, and relational evidence. Relative synchronization requires no additional anchor, whereas hand-off at an absolute time requires exactly one. The analysis there- fore provides a task-relative stopping condition for representational alignment: residual disagreement need not be eliminated when it is invariant with respect to the interaction.

</details>


### [140] [Subject-Specific Predictive Musculoskeletal Simulations of Lower-Limb Exoskeleton Assistance: Metabolic and Biomechanical Effects of Joint Assistance Strategies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02991)
*Neethan Ratnakumar,Mariya Tohfafarosha,Xianlian Zhou*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本研究用受试者特异性肌骨模型预测模拟，系统评估下肢各关节助力组合的能量最优策略，发现髋+踝为高效双 actuator 方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 下肢外骨骼虽能降低步行能耗，但最优助力策略设计困难，尤其受个体间体型与生物力学差异影响，需弄清不同关节与助力幅度的能量学效果。

Method: 基于六名健康受试者的特异性肌骨模型（按 BMI 缩放肌力），在自选步速下开展预测仿真；加入理想执行器，实现 25 Nm 与 50 Nm 峰值下多种单关节、双关节及髋-膝-踝组合助力，并以 COT、关节运动学、肌肉激活、助力力矩与关节功率指标评估效果。

Result: 50 Nm 时 H+K+A 组合 COT 平均降低 48.50±4.55%（个体 42.22%–54.65%）；单关节中髋最有效（31.77±5.21%），膝与踝较小且相近（19.17%、17.02%）；双关节中 H+A 最优（44.60±7.08%）。提高力矩上限主要增加髋、踝正助力功率，膝助力敏感性低且正功率出现在预摆动期。

Conclusion: H+A 是高效的双执行器助力目标；膝在预摆动期的非典型功率策略值得针对性实验验证。

Abstract: Lower-limb exoskeletons have made considerable progress in reducing energy expenditure during walking. However, designing optimal assistance strategies remains challenging, particularly given inter-individual variability in anthropometry and biomechanics. This study explores energy-optimal lower-limb joint-assistance strategies using predictive simulations with musculoskeletal models. Subject-specific models of six able-bodied subjects, with BMI-based muscle strength scaling, were used in predictive simulations to generate gait at self-selected walking speeds. Ideal actuators were incorporated to simulate various combinations of joint assistance at peak levels of 25 Nm and 50 Nm to examine the effects of assistance on gait and metabolic savings. The effects of each assistance configuration were assessed through cost of transport (COT), joint kinematics, muscle activations, assistive torques, and joint-level power metrics to characterize the biomechanical and energetic impacts of different assistance strategies. At 50 Nm, combined H+K+A (hip-knee-ankle) assistance resulted in the greatest mean COT reduction of 48.50 +/- 4.55%, with individual reductions ranging from 42.22% to 54.65% across the subjects. Among single-joint conditions, assisting the hip was most effective, reducing COT by 31.77 +/- 5.21%; the knee and ankle produced smaller, comparable reductions (19.17% and 17.02%). H+A (hip-ankle) assistance (44.60 +/- 7.08%) emerged as the most effective two-joint assistive configuration. Increasing the torque bound increased positive assistive power primarily at the hip and ankle, while knee assistance showed little sensitivity and delivered positive power near pre-swing. These results support H+A assistance as an efficient two-actuator target, while identifying the knee's atypical pre-swing power strategy as a candidate for targeted experimental validation.

</details>


### [141] [Safe Streaming Flow Planning by Aligning Sampling Dynamics with Execution Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03132)
*Seunghwan Jang,Jeongyong Yang,Siddharth Ancha,SooJean Han*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该研究提出 SafeStreamingFlow，一种基于流匹配的目标条件规划器，通过将流采样动力学与执行动力学对齐，并按需对执行步施加高阶控制屏障函数约束，实现低延迟在线重规划与安全保障。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实部署要求生成式规划器（扩散/流匹配）在执行时满足安全约束，并支持快速在线重规划。现有安全扩散/流规划器一次性生成完整轨迹，并反复扰动中间状态以满足约束，导致计算开销大，且因采样动力学与系统执行动力学不一致而引入分布偏移。

Method: 提出 SafeStreamingFlow：目标条件规划器，将学习到的状态向量场顺序积分，并结合分层状态预测，使流采样动力学与执行动力学对齐；仅对实际执行的那一步，利用高阶控制屏障函数（HOCBF）施加安全约束。

Result: 在导航、竞速、运动控制等基准上，SafeStreamingFlow 相较现有方法降低了规划延迟并提升了安全性，同时保持具有竞争力的目标达成成功率。

Conclusion: 通过将采样动力学与执行动力学对齐并按步安全约束，SafeStreamingFlow 在安全性与实时性之间取得更好权衡，验证了流式生成规划在安全在线重规划场景中的有效性。

Abstract: Generative planners based on diffusion/flow matching can learn to synthesize long-horizon trajectories from demonstrations. However, real-world deployment requires (i) enforcing safety constraints during execution and (ii) tight online replanning at fast execution rates. Prior safe diffusion/flow planners generate the agent's full trajectory at once, while repeatedly perturbing intermediate states to satisfy safety constraints. This approach is not only computationally intensive, but also introduces distribution shift since the learned sampling dynamics is distinct from the system's execution dynamics. We propose SafeStreamingFlow, a goal-conditioned planner that aligns flow sampling dynamics with execution dynamics by sequentially integrating a learned state vector field with hierarchical state prediction. Importantly, we need to enforce safety constraints only for the executed step via high order control barrier functions. Across navigation, racing, and locomotion benchmarks, SafeStreamingFlow reduces planning latency and improves safety compared to existing methods, while maintaining competitive goal-reaching success.

</details>


### [142] [Beyond Reward Hacking: Proxy Divergence Across Four Layers of a Staged Humanoid Learning Pipeline](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03196)
*Arunabh Bora*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该文主张强化学习腿足机器人流水线中的奖励、课程门控、评估统计与参考运动四者本质都是代理指标，各有特征性偏离机制，并逐层给出可闭合偏离的替代公式；用单一 PPO 血统、四阶段 13,500 次迭代的 1.91 m 仿真人形测量予以佐证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统观点只把奖励视为被优化的代理，因而将规格失效（奖励黑客）仅归因于奖励本身；作者认为这种定位不完整，课程、评估与参考运动同样存在代理偏离，需要统一的代理视角来诊断和修正。

Method: 对四层代理逐一声明传统公式、推导其偏离目标的条件，并给出替代方案：二次核平坦处改用一阶（L1）代价；课程门控由平均误差改为峰值与结果统计，并加入可达性与信息检查；评估采用确定性与相位去同步化；课程状态纳入模型；参考运动采用可行性优先设计加残差前馈；输入加宽采用保函数方式使单一策略可生长而非重训。

Result: 在单一 PPO 血统、四阶段共 13,500 次迭代的 1.91 m 仿真人形上测得：基于平均误差的课程门控在每次检查时都按速率上限推进，而其本应门控的技能尚未习得；批量推力测试中同步复位与步态相位产生混叠，将 0.5 m/s 推力误判为比 2.0 m/s 更危险。

Conclusion: 奖励、课程门控、评估统计与参考运动均属同一形式意义上的代理指标，各自具有可推导的偏离机制，也可通过相应重述予以闭合；实证表明未加处理时课程与评估层会独立失效，故规格失效的定位与修复不能局限于奖励。

Abstract: A reinforcement-learning (RL) pipeline for a legged robot is assembled from proxies. A reward stands in for intended behaviour, a curriculum gate stands in for competence, an evaluation statistic stands in for robustness, and a reference motion stands in for an achievable skill. The traditional view treats only the first of these as optimised against, and so locates specification failure (reward hacking) in the reward alone. I argue that all four are proxies in the same formal sense, that each has a characteristic divergence mechanism, and that each admits a reformulation that closes it. For every layer I state the traditional formulation, derive the condition under which it diverges from its target, and give the alternative: first-order (L1) costs where quadratic kernels are flat, peak and outcome statistics where curriculum gates average, gate reachability and information checks, deterministic and phase-desynchronised evaluation, curriculum state treated as part of the model, feasibility-first reference design with residual feed-forward, and function-preserving input widening that lets one policy grow instead of being retrained. The arguments are illustrated by measurements from one continuous lineage of a PPO policy for a simulated 1.91 m humanoid, grown over four stages and 13,500 iterations on a single laptop GPU. Among them, a curriculum gate built on averaged error advanced at its rate limit on every check while the skill it gated was absent, and a batched push test whose synchronised resets aliased the gait phase ranked a 0.5 m/s push as more dangerous than a 2.0 m/s one.

</details>


### [143] [DexJoCo-X: Benchmarking Action Representations for Multi-Hand Dexterous Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03278)
*Xiangwei Jiang,Yao Mu,Lixin Duan,Wen Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出DexJoCo-X基准与工具包，在7种灵巧手、6类任务、2100条演示上进行受控对比，发现跨本体学习需动作坐标、预训练与架构三者协同。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 灵巧手形态日益多样，为每种形态单独采集数据与训练策略不可扩展，因此需要统一的跨本体表示，既能捕捉共享的操作结构，又能保留各形态特有的控制方式。但现有研究因手部、任务、数据集与控制接口的差异，无法分离表示、预训练与架构各自的作用。

Method: 构建DexJoCo-X基准与工具包：覆盖7种代表性灵巧手、6个单臂与双臂任务、2100条均衡演示；提供统一场景、成功判据与执行接口的匹配式多手多任务协议，重新设计手套到手部的映射，并搭建自动流水线将经审核演示扩展到随机化场景中。基于π_{0.5}、Ego-Pi、Being-H0.5三种方法检验共享动作接口是否足以支撑多手学习。

Result: 将π_{0.5}扩展为80维双臂输出后成功率接近零；Ego-Pi通过交错预测保留预训练动作头并支持单手多任务学习，但七手联合训练仍无效；Being-H0.5结合跨本体预训练、统一动作空间与本体感知专家，实现单一策略控制全部7种手。在该架构内，功能对齐动作槽平均成功率为47.7%，原生坐标为47.0%，DexLatent为33.1%。

Conclusion: 跨本体表示取决于整个学习系统：动作坐标、预训练与架构必须协同，才能将共享操作结构与本体特有控制分离开来。

Abstract: As dexterous hands proliferate, collecting data and training policies separately for every morphology becomes increasingly impractical. Scalable cross-embodiment learning therefore requires a unified representation that captures shared manipulation structure while preserving morphology-specific control. Differences in hands, tasks, datasets, and control interfaces prevent existing studies from isolating the effects of representation, pretraining, and architecture. We introduce DexJoCo-X, a benchmark and toolkit for controlled comparison across seven representative dexterous hands, six single-arm and bimanual tasks, and 2,100 balanced demonstrations. DexJoCo-X provides a matched multi-hand, multi-task protocol with common scenes, success criteria, and execution interfaces, redesigned glove-to-hand mappings, and an automated pipeline that expands reviewed demonstrations across randomized scenes. Using $π_{0.5}$, Ego-Pi, and Being-H0.5, we examine whether a shared action interface is sufficient for multi-hand learning. Expanding $π_{0.5}$ to an 80-dimensional bimanual output yields near-zero success. Ego-Pi preserves the pretrained action head through interleaved prediction and supports per-hand multi-task learning, but remains ineffective for seven-hand joint training. By contrast, Being-H0.5 combines cross-embodiment pretraining, a unified action space, and embodiment-aware experts, enabling one policy to control all seven hands. Within this architecture, function-aligned action slots achieve 47.7% mean success, compared with 47.0% for native coordinates and 33.1% for DexLatent. These results show that cross-embodiment representation depends on the entire learning system: action coordinates, pretraining, and architecture must jointly separate shared manipulation structure from embodiment-specific control.

</details>


### [144] [HexVIO: Towards All-Day Stereo-Inertial Tracking Through Commodity DSPs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03283)
*Patrick Wolf,Mateo de Mayo,Daniel Cremers*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: HexVIO将立体惯性里程计的视觉前端卸载到Hexagon DSP、后端保留在CPU，在手机上实现功耗降低67%或吞吐提升86%，以0.83 W支撑30 fps实时跟踪约18小时。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉惯性里程计（VIO）是空间计算中设备自定位的基础能力，机器人、可穿戴设备、XR设备与无人机均可受益于其高效实现，从而获得更轻薄、更低成本、更长续航的设备与更好的用户体验。

Method: 利用现代智能手机与XR设备中普遍存在的Hexagon DSP协处理器，将立体惯性里程计的视觉前端卸载至DSP执行、后端保留在主CPU，并针对DSP架构进行实现优化。

Result: 相比纯CPU执行，功耗降低67%或吞吐量提升86%；在商用手机上可持续以0.83 W实现30 fps长期实时跟踪，对应测试设备上约18小时的跟踪时长。

Conclusion: 结果表明，商用DSP具备在机器人与移动设备中实现全天候视觉惯性跟踪的潜力。

Abstract: The ability of a device to localize itself within its surroundings is a fundamental prerequisite for spatial computing. Visual-inertial odometry (VIO) has proven to be a cost-effective and accurate solution for this task. Robots, wearables, XR devices, and drones can benefit significantly from efficient implementations of VIO since they allow for cooler, lighter, and cheaper devices with longer battery life and a better user experience. In this work, we propose to enhance the efficiency of a VIO system by leveraging the Hexagon DSP, a commodity co-processor present in many modern smartphones and XR devices. Our approach offloads the visual frontend of a stereo-inertial odometry system to the DSP while keeping the backend on the main CPU. By optimizing the implementation for the DSP architecture, we achieve significant reductions in power consumption and latency compared to CPU-only execution. Our system, HexVIO, demonstrates a 67% reduction in power consumption or an 86% increase in throughput on a commodity smartphone, with the ability to sustain long-term real-time 30 fps tracking for 0.83 W, corresponding to ~18 hours of tracking on the testing device. These results highlight the potential of commodity DSPs for enabling all-day visual-inertial tracking in robotics and mobile devices.

</details>


### [145] [Equivariant Visual-Tactile Diffusion Policy for Contact-Rich Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03333)
*Lik Hang Kenny Wong,Yiyao Ma,Xiu-Shen Wei,Zelong Tan,Zhuheng Song,Dongsheng Xie,Kai Chen,Qi Dou*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: VISTA：一种工作空间级等变视触觉扩散策略，通过球面token化与等变融合提升接触密集操作模仿学习的数据效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 接触密集操作的模仿学习依赖昂贵的高质量专家数据，如何学习样本高效（数据高效）的策略是关键问题。

Method: VISTA将视觉与触觉观测投影为球面token，通过置换等变球面融合把触觉接触线索注入视觉球面方向，并利用末端执行器姿态旋转融合后的谐波表示；该表示条件化一个等变扩散策略，从而预测空间一致的動作。

Result: 在仿真与真实机器人环境中的大量实验表明，VISTA相比强视触觉模仿学习基线显著提升数据效率。

Conclusion: VISTA通过工作空间级等变表示与扩散策略结合，有效缓解接触密集模仿学习的数据依赖问题，具有良好的数据效率与泛化潜力。

Abstract: Imitation learning for contact-rich manipulation requires high-quality expert data that is expensive to obtain. This makes learning a sample-efficient policy a key issue. To address this, we propose VISTA, a workspace-level equivariant visuotactile diffusion policy for data-efficient contact-rich imitation learning. VISTA projects visual and tactile observations into spherical tokens, injects tactile contact cues into visual spherical directions through permutation-equivariant spherical fusion, and rotates the fused harmonic representation using the end-effector orientation. The resulting representation conditions an equivariant diffusion policy to predict spatially consistent actions. Extensive experiments in both simulation and real-world robotic settings show that VISTA substantially improves data efficiency over strong visuotactile imitation learning baselines. Project website: https://vista-paper.github.io/

</details>


### [146] [KungfuAthleteBot: learning high-dynamic humanoid motion from video with unified robust recovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03388)
*Zhongxiang Lei,Lulu Cao,Xuyang Wang,Tianyi Qian,Jinyan Liu,Xuesong Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: KungfuAthleteBot (KAB) 将"从视频学习高动态人形机器人运动"作为核心问题，针对视频数据的三大缺陷（物理不一致、缺乏驱动力信息、无失败/恢复信息）逐一提出解决方案，实现约0.7秒的最快统一策略跌倒恢复。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频是丰富且廉价的人体运动数据来源，富含极限运动行为。但直接将其用于人形机器人并非简单重定向重建轨迹即可：视频衍生的运动在物理上不一致、缺乏驱动力（actuation）信息，且不包含失败与恢复的相关信息。作者认为修复与补偿视频数据（而非仅收集更多数据）才是解锁高动态人形技能的关键。

Method: (C1) 构建 KungfuAthlete 数据集（来自国家级武术运动员视频），提出物理引导的抛物轨迹校正，消除重建的腾空与落地阶段中的高度漂浮、穿地及高频抖动。(C2) 引入物理驱动的伪低动能（LKE）采样，将策略初始化偏向动力学可行状态，使策略能发现可行驱动力模式而非模仿不可行参考。(C3) 引入直接训练范式，在同一策略内同时学习抗扰与跌倒恢复，无需恢复参考数据，也无需人工模式切换。

Result: 在人形机器人上，KAB 能从视频学习动态技能，并在约0.7秒内从任意跌倒中恢复，为已报告的统一策略中最快恢复速度。对统一策略的消融实验证实了各组成部分的必要性。

Conclusion: 修复和补偿视频数据（而非仅收集更多数据）是解锁高动态人形机器人技能的关键。该方法验证了将视频运动数据转化为可用机器人技能需解决物理一致性、驱动力信息缺失及失败恢复三大问题。

Abstract: Video is an abundant, inexpensive source of human motion data that is rich in extreme athletic behaviors. Making it usable for humanoid robots, however, is not a matter of simply retargeting a reconstructed trajectory: video-derived motion is physically inconsistent, devoid of actuation information, and says nothing about failure or recovery. We present KungfuAthleteBot (KAB), a framework that treats learning high-dynamic motion from video as the central problem and resolves each of these three failure modes in turn. (C1) We build the KungfuAthlete dataset from videos of national-level martial artists and introduce a physics-guided parabolic trajectory correction that removes height floating, ground penetration, and high-frequency jitter from reconstructed aerial and landing phases. (C2) Because video carries no force information, strict tracking of a reconstructed trajectory is dynamically infeasible, and error-driven initialization keeps re-launching the policy from infeasible aerial poses. We introduce physics-driven pseudo-low-kinetic-energy (LKE) sampling, our central mechanism for making such references learnable: it biases initialization towards dynamically feasible states, letting the policy discover feasible actuation patterns instead of imitating infeasible ones. (C3) Finally, we introduce a direct training paradigm in which disturbance rejection and fall recovery are learned inside the same policy that tracks the video motion, requiring no recovery reference data and no manual mode switching. On a humanoid robot, KAB learns dynamic skills from video and recovers from arbitrary falls in about 0.7 s, the fastest reported recovery for a unified policy. Ablations on the unified policy confirm the necessity of its components, supporting the view that repairing and compensating video data, rather than only collecting more of it, is what unlocks high-dynamic humanoid skills.

</details>


### [147] [I2CD: Direct Image-to-Convex Decomposition for Simulation-Ready Collision Geometry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03453)
*Qian Wang,Liam Merz Hoffmeister,Brian Scassellati,Daniel Rakita*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: I2CD 直接从单张 RGB 图像预测凸分解，冻结预训练 Hunyuan3D-2，仅训练 38M 参数的交叉注意力头输出 K 个凸多面体的半平面参数，输出天然凸、无需后处理，速度与体积 IoU 均优于八种"重建-再分解"流程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 物理仿真器与运动规划需要凸碰撞几何，而图像到 3D 生成模型输出的是稠密、常非流形的视觉网格。现有桥接方式是"先重建再分解"的流水线（修复、简化、近似凸分解），速度慢且脆弱。

Method: 冻结预训练的 Hunyuan3D-2 图像条件扩散 Transformer 与形状解码器，仅训练一个轻量交叉注意力头（38M 参数，<10 GPU 小时）；其学习的"凸槽（convex-slot）"token 直接输出 K 个凸多面体的半平面参数，实现单图直接预测凸分解。

Result: 在 227 个 OmniObject3D 与 Google Scanned Objects 留出实例上，I2CD 在八种重建-再分解流程中取得最高体积 IoU，端到端快 6–37×，单图约 0.5s。跨仿真器测试（MuJoCo、PyBullet、Genesis、Isaac Sim）中所有引擎可直接使用 I2CD 几何，而原始生成网格多数被静默替换为不同碰撞形状或需秒至分钟级预处理。物理 xArm7 上，20 物体杂乱场景生成规划可用几何耗时 11s（最强基线 328s），抓放成功率相当（85/100 对 90/100）。

Conclusion: I2CD 以极低训练成本实现从单图到物理引擎可直接加载的紧凑凸分解，兼顾精度与效率，在跨仿真器与真实机器人场景中验证了实用性。

Abstract: Physics simulators and motion planners require convex collision geometry, yet image-to-3D generative models output dense, frequently non-manifold visual meshes. Bridging the two today takes a slow, brittle reconstruct-then-decompose pipeline of repair, decimation, and approximate convex decomposition. We present I2CD, which predicts a convex decomposition directly from a single RGB image. Rather than train a new image-to-3D model, I2CD freezes the pretrained Hunyuan3D-2 image-conditioned diffusion transformer and shape decoder and trains only a lightweight cross-attention head (38M parameters, under ten GPU-hours) whose learned "convex-slot" tokens emit the halfplane parameters of $K$ convex polytopes. The output is compact, convex by construction, and loads into physics engines without any post-processing, in ${\sim}0.5$s per image. On $227$ held-out OmniObject3D and Google Scanned Objects instances, I2CD attains the highest volumetric IoU among eight reconstruct-then-decompose pipelines while running $6$-$37\times$ faster end-to-end. In a cross-simulator study in MuJoCo, PyBullet, Genesis, and Isaac Sim, every engine uses I2CD geometry as delivered, whereas raw generated meshes "load" everywhere but are silently replaced by a different collision shape in most cases or need seconds to minutes of per-object preprocessing. On a physical xArm7, I2CD produces planner-ready geometry for a $20$-object cluttered scene in $11$s versus $328$s for the strongest baseline, at comparable pick-and-place execution success ($85$ vs. $90$ of $100$ trials).

</details>


### [148] [MobiAgent: Dual-Loop Recursive Policy Self-Improvement for Long-Horizon Mobile Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03476)
*Chenzhi Liu,Yue Zhang,Jiehong Lin,Jianan Wang,Bo Wang,Zhongrui Wang,Xiaojuan Qi*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: MobiAgent：双循环智能体框架，内循环用可组合原子技能解耦高层推理与底层控制，外循环自主终身学习发现并微调技能库，解决长时程移动操作中的累积误差与容量干扰问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时程移动操作面临执行误差累积、运动与机械臂控制间的容量干扰；现有VLA模型擅长短时程任务，缺乏多阶段目标所需的层次推理；已有层次智能体存在子任务映射僵化、重规划不灵活、缺乏持续学习等问题。

Method: 提出双循环智能体框架MobiAgent。内循环：通过高度可组合的原子技能解耦高层推理与底层控制，用视觉语言模型进行滚动时域规划与视觉反思，动态组合技能实现错误恢复；技能由共享统一VLM骨干的专用流匹配专家执行，兼顾复用性与缓解容量干扰。外循环：自动分割并验证部署轨迹，聚类发现原子技能，无需人工标注持续微调技能库，实现自动化终身学习。

Result: 在RoboCasa、BEHAVIOR-1K及真实世界任务上验证有效性：在BEHAVIOR-1K上超过π_{0.5}-TA达22.5个百分点，并能从执行失败中稳健恢复；通过自主数据回收，RoboCasa成功率从7.50%提升至27.50%，Astribot S1从32.5%提升至57.5%。

Conclusion: MobiAgent通过双循环设计统一了稳健部署执行与递归策略自我改进，证明了层次化、可组合技能与自主终身学习在长时程移动操作中的有效性与可扩展性。

Abstract: Long-horizon mobile manipulation presents significant challenges due to compounding execution errors and capacity interference between locomotion and arm control. While recent Vision-Language-Action models excel at short-horizon tasks, they lack the hierarchical reasoning required for multi-stage objectives. Furthermore, existing hierarchical agents suffer from rigid sub-task mapping, inflexible replanning, and a lack of continuous learning. To address these limitations, we introduce MobiAgent, a dual-loop agentic framework that bridges robust deployment execution and recursive policy self-improvement. During deployment, the Inner Loop decouples high-level reasoning from low-level control through highly composable atomic skills. It employs Vision-Language models for receding-horizon planning and visual reflection, dynamically composing skills to ensure robust error recovery. These skills are executed by specialized flow-matching experts that share a unified VLM backbone, maximizing reusability while mitigating capacity interference. Concurrently, the Outer Loop drives automated lifelong learning by autonomously segmenting and verifying deployment rollouts, clustering them to discover atomic skills, and continuously fine-tuning the skill library without human annotations. Evaluations on RoboCasa, BEHAVIOR-1K, and real-world tasks demonstrate the effectiveness of MobiAgent. It outperforms $π_{0.5}$-TA by 22.5 percentage points on BEHAVIOR-1K and enables robust recovery from execution failures. Through autonomous data recycling, success improves from 7.50% to 27.50% on RoboCasa and from 32.5% to 57.5% on Astribot S1.

</details>


### [149] [Detect and Suppress: A Mechanistic Defense against Adversarial Patches in VLA Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03498)
*Yukiya Horiba,Koshiro Aoki,Shunsuke Yasuki,Bum Jun Kim,Taiki Miyanishi*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文用稀疏自编码器（SAE）机制性分析VLA模型的内部表征，定位到与对抗补丁强相关的特征，并在推理时通过线性探针检测攻击后条件性地抑制该特征，从而在不微调模型的情况下提升鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对抗补丁可通过操纵视觉观测破坏VLA模型，导致机器人控制失败，但目前对其内部失效机制以及如何通过针对性干预加以缓解的理解仍很有限。

Method: 使用稀疏自编码器（SAE）对VLA表征进行机制性分析，识别出激活与对抗补丁存在强相关的特征；基于该分析，仅在推理阶段、由线性探针检测到攻击时抑制该特征，无需对VLA进行微调。

Result: 在LIBERO-10上针对VLA对抗补丁攻击进行评估：条件性干预在间歇性攻击下提升了成功率，而持续施加相同干预则显著降低策略性能。

Conclusion: 攻击相关的内部表征可作为VLA对抗防御的有效靶点，且控制干预时机对于减少对正常策略行为的干扰至关重要。

Abstract: Adversarial patches can disrupt Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models by manipulating visual observations, leading to failures in robot control. However, it remains poorly understood which internal mechanisms underlie these failures and how targeted interventions can mitigate them. In this work, we mechanistically analyze VLA representations using a sparse autoencoder (SAE) and identify a feature whose activation strongly correlates with the presence of an adversarial patch. Based on this analysis, we suppress the identified feature at inference time only when a linear probe detects an attack. This intervention improves robustness without the cost of fine-tuning the VLA. We evaluate our method against VLA adversarial patch attacks on LIBERO-10. Conditional intervention improves success rate under intermittent attacks, whereas continuously applying the same intervention substantially degrades policy performance. These results show that attack-related internal representations can provide useful targets for VLA adversarial defense and that controlling when to intervene is important for limiting disruption to nominal policy behavior.

</details>


### [150] [XGenAct: Geometry-Enhanced World Action Models through Cross-Task Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03516)
*Tingting Du,Ziyao Wang,Guoheng Sun,Ang Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出XGenAct世界动作模型，用统一视频扩散Transformer将RGB、动作、度量深度、表面法线和功能角色分割编码为RGB视频，通过采样多种感知与动作任务以单一目标训练，在RLBench上取得52%成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于RGB与动作的未来预测未显式建模机器人操作所需的空间理解；已有工作仅通过专用头或分支增加少量空间预测任务，导致空间监督范围与模型架构割裂。

Method: 用确定性编解码器将RGB观测、机器人动作、度量深度、表面法线及功能角色分割统一表示为RGB视频；训练时采样不同感知与动作任务，使用单一视频扩散Transformer和单一目标进行时序预测，无需模态专用的可学习头。

Result: 在留出的RLBench任务上，结构化感知训练相比仅RGB训练提升了平均闭环成功率；在五项任务外部对比中XGenAct成功率达52%，最强基线为26%；其预测未来深度与分割的精度也优于先生成RGB再应用冻结感知专家的对比流程。

Conclusion: 统一的多空间视频建模范式能有效增强世界动作模型的空间理解能力，提升机器人操作闭环成功率与未来感知预测精度。

Abstract: World action models (WAMs) have advanced robot control by predicting how observations and actions evolve over time. Despite this progress, RGB and action based future prediction does not explicitly address the spatial understanding needed for robot manipulation. Existing efforts often add a limited set of spatial prediction tasks through specialized heads or branches, leaving both the range of spatial supervision and the model architecture fragmented. We introduce XGenAct, a world action model that represents RGB observations, robot actions, metric depth, surface normals, and functional role segmentation as RGB videos through deterministic codecs. By sampling perception and action tasks during training, XGenAct uses one video diffusion transformer and one objective to learn temporal prediction across these spaces without modality specific learned heads. On held out RLBench tasks, structured perception training improves average closed loop success over RGB only training, and XGenAct achieves 52% success in the five task external comparison, versus 26% for the strongest evaluated baselines. It also predicts future depth and segmentation more accurately than the evaluated pipelines that generate RGB first and then apply a frozen perception expert.

</details>


### [151] [DR-IPC: Disturbance-Resilient Integrated Planning and Control for LiDAR-Based Quadrotor Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03530)
*Peng Liu,Jingyan Wang,Qipeng Ye,Wen Li,Jinya Su,Zuo Wang,Shihua Li,Yunda Yan*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出扰动鲁棒集成规划与控制（DR-IPC）框架，将轻量路径引导与非线性模型预测控制（NMPC）结合，直接输出角速度与推力，实现LiDAR四旋翼在杂乱环境中的抗扰导航，机载运行频率100 Hz。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LiDAR四旋翼在杂乱环境中的导航在外扰下仍具挑战，尤其当避障运动生成与抗扰控制被分层独立处理时，层间耦合不足导致性能受限。

Method: 采用轻量路径引导＋NMPC的集成架构，直接生成角速度与推力；通过互联的扩展卡尔曼滤波与非线性扰动观测器联合提供滤波状态估计与重构扰动，用于NMPC预测；统一建模非线性四旋翼动力学、执行器约束、局部运动生成与安全飞行走廊残差惩罚，无需独立轨迹优化阶段。

Result: Gazebo与MARSIM仿真及室内外实验验证了风扰、悬挂负载、狭窄通道、球体撞击与动态障碍反应式避障场景；多目标导航中Gazebo完成任务数由1/10提升至9/10，实验中高度RMSE由0.34 m降至0.01 m，系统机载运行于100 Hz。

Conclusion: DR-IPC通过规划与控制的深度集成及扰动观测，显著提升四旋翼在杂乱环境与外扰下的任务完成率与轨迹跟踪精度，具备机载实时性。

Abstract: LiDAR-based quadrotor navigation in cluttered environments remains challenging under external disturbances, particularly when obstacle-aware motion generation and disturbance-rejection control are handled in separate layers. This article presents disturbance-resilient integrated planning and control (DR-IPC), which combines lightweight path guidance with nonlinear model predictive control (NMPC) to directly generate angular velocity and thrust. An interconnected extended Kalman filter and nonlinear disturbance observer jointly provide filtered state estimates and reconstructed disturbances for NMPC prediction. The resulting formulation unifies nonlinear quadrotor dynamics, actuator constraints, local motion generation, and penalised safe-flight-corridor residuals without requiring a separate trajectory-optimization stage. Gazebo and MARSIM simulations, together with indoor and outdoor experiments, validate DR-IPC under wind, suspended payloads, narrow passages, ball impacts and reactive avoidance of a dynamic obstacle. In multi-goal navigation with disturbances, DR-IPC increases the number of completed missions from 1/10 to 9/10 in Gazebo and reduces the altitude RMSE from 0.34 to 0.01 m in experiments. The complete system operates onboard at 100 Hz. Supplementary videos are available on the project page https://drpp316.github.io/DR-IPC-Page/, and the source code will be released.

</details>


### [152] [Autonomous Robotic Navigation for Endovascular Brain-Computer Interface Access](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03537)
*Harry Robertshaw,Weijie Qi,Nikola Fischer,Alejandro Granados,Thomas C. Booth,Sam E. John*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该工作首次在体外演示了脑血管静脉系统内自主机器人导航用于血管内脑机接口（BCI）递送，采用Soft Actor-Critic控制器完成两阶段导航任务，并在仿真与体外实验中评估成功率及在线失效预测能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 血管内BCI可避免开颅，但需在解剖结构多变的脑静脉中精准递送器械，自主导航与失效预警对安全性和临床转化至关重要。

Method: 用单一训练解剖的几何增强在仿真中训练Soft Actor-Critic控制器，完成从右颈内静脉到上矢状窦的两个连续任务；在训练解剖和解剖未见留出模型上，进行250个仿真回合及每任务-解剖条件5次透视引导体外机器人运行（共1000个仿真回合、20次实体运行）；同时评估任务循环预测器在线识别即将发生的导航失效。

Result: 仿真中任务A、B成功率在训练解剖为85.6%和98.4%，在留出解剖为42.0%和91.6%；20次实体运行中14次成功（总体70%），其中留出体模任务B成功率为80%。仿真中预测器检测到99.3-100.0%的失效，虚警率为0.8-6.7%；体外评估中失败回合前预测风险升高，但部分成功回合概率偏高，显示迁移后校准下降。

Conclusion: 结果证明自主脑静脉通路可行，在线失效预测可支持人类监督，但解剖泛化与仿真到现实校准仍是临床前转化前需优先解决的问题。

Abstract: Endovascular brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) avoid craniotomy but require precise device delivery through anatomically variable cerebral veins. This work presents the first demonstration of in vitro autonomous robotic navigation for endovascular BCI access in the cerebral venous system. Soft Actor-Critic controllers were trained in silico for two sequential tasks spanning the right internal jugular vein to the superior sagittal sinus, using geometric augmentation of one training anatomy. Navigation was evaluated in a training anatomy and an anatomically unseen hold-out model over 250 in silico episodes and five fluoroscopy-guided in vitro robotic runs per task-anatomy condition, comprising 1,000 simulated episodes and 20 physical runs overall. Task recurrent predictors were also evaluated for online identification of impending navigation failure. In silico success rates for Tasks A and B were 85.6% and 98.4% in the training anatomy and 42.0% and 91.6% in the hold-out anatomy, respectively. Fourteen of 20 physical runs were successful (70% overall), including 80% success for Task B in the hold-out phantom. In silico the predictors detected 99.3-100.0% of failures with false-alarm rates of 0.8-6.7%. During in vitro evaluation, predicted risk increased before failed episodes, but elevated probabilities during some successful runs showed reduced calibration after transfer. These results demonstrate the feasibility of autonomous cerebral venous access and show how online failure prediction could support human oversight, while also identifying anatomical generalization and sim-to-real calibration as priorities before preclinical translation.

</details>


### [153] [RATE: Risk-Aware Tactile Encoding for Contact-rich Robotic Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03538)
*Yuyao Jiang,Haichao Liu,Jiarui Zheng,Zihan Ding,Weihao Yuan,Ziwei Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出风险感知触觉编码RATE，学习任务条件下的交互风险表征，通过历史条件预测与警报监督，并用轻量残差适配器补充常规触觉特征，在仿真与真实任务中显著提升成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 触觉对接触密集型机器人操作很重要，现有触觉表征学习虽进展显著，但相似触觉观察可能来自风险含义完全不同的交互条件（传感器噪声、任务必需变化、突发不良接触）。缺乏基于上下文的风险信息时，下游策略难以区分这些情况，导致对良性变化做多余修正，或对真正风险接触响应延迟。

Method: RATE（Risk-Aware Tactile Encoding）：用历史条件预测捕捉交互上下文，用警报监督把该上下文与任务条件下的风险关联；学习到的风险感知表征通过轻量残差适配器与常规触觉特征互补结合。

Result: 在仿真和真实世界实验中，任务成功率获得显著提升；受控消融实验证实了警报引导学习和预测性时序建模的互补增益。

Conclusion: 将任务条件下的交互风险显式编码进触觉表征，可缓解相似触觉观测的歧义问题，且与常规触觉特征互补，有效提升接触密集型操作任务表现。

Abstract: Tactile sensing is particularly valuable for contact-rich robotic manipulation. Recent work has made substantial progress in tactile representation learning for robotic manipulation. However, similar tactile observations can arise from interaction conditions with very different task-risk implications, such as sensor noise, task-necessary variations, and emerging undesirable contact. Without context-grounded risk information, these cases can be ambiguous to downstream policies, leading to unnecessary corrections to benign variations or delayed responses to genuinely risky contact. To address this limitation, we propose Risk-Aware Tactile Encoding (RATE), which learns tactile representations that encode task-conditioned interaction risk. Specifically, history-conditioned prediction captures interaction context, while alert supervision associates this context with task-conditioned risk. The learned risk-aware representation complements conventional tactile features through a lightweight residual adapter. Experiments in both simulation and the real world demonstrate substantial improvements in task success, with controlled ablations confirming the complementary benefits of alert-guided learning and predictive temporal modeling.

</details>


### [154] [A Unified Framework for Empowerment and Predictive Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03563)
*Wooyoung Chung,Tristan Shah,Volodymyr Makarenko,Stas Tiomkin*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于单一策略的 empowerment 目标，仅需一阶导数即可用标准 MPC 求解器优化，实现与标准 MPC 的兼容。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 采样型 MPC 依赖需大量领域知识设计的信息性代价函数，而基于系统动力学的无目标方法（如 empowerment）可避免此问题。但现有 empowerment 控制器存在两大局限：其一，empowerment 用与执行控制策略不同的虚拟探测策略估计，削弱了其与实际行为的关联；其二，其计算通常需要动力学的二阶导数，限制了与标准 MPC 方法的兼容性。

Method: 用同一策略同时进行探测与动作，将 empowerment 目标直接与执行行为关联；由此得到的优化目标仅需一阶导数，可使用标准 MPC 求解器优化，既可单独使用，也可与任务特定代价结合。

Result: 在经典控制任务上评估，将 empowerment 与任务代价结合，其成功率与两者单独使用相比达到或超过。

Conclusion: 该公式在标准 MPC 与内在动机控制之间提供了实用的桥梁。

Abstract: Sampling-based model predictive control (MPC) is a powerful approach to trajectory optimization, but its performance depends on an informative cost function that often requires substantial domain knowledge to design. An alternative is to derive objectives directly from the system dynamics. Empowerment, defined as the channel capacity between an agent's inputs and its future state, provides such a goal-agnostic objective and has been shown to produce useful behaviors across a range of domains. However, existing empowerment-based controllers have two key limitations: empowerment is estimated using a virtual probing policy distinct from the executed control policy, obscuring its connection to the resulting behavior; and its computation typically requires second-order derivatives of the dynamics, limiting compatibility with standard MPC methods. We formulate empowerment using a single policy for both probing and acting, directly linking the empowerment objective to the executed behavior. The resulting objective requires only first-order derivatives and can be optimized with standard MPC solvers, either alone or in combination with a task-specific cost. We evaluate the proposed approach on classical control tasks and show that combining empowerment with task costs matches or exceeds the success rate achieved by either objective alone. Our formulation provides a practical bridge between standard MPC and intrinsically motivated control.

</details>


### [155] [AVL-JEPA: Preventing Causal Dynamics Information Collapse In Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03587)
*Yikang Qiao,Ling Zhang,Ziying Song,Duan Huang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出"因果动力学信息坍缩"这一失效模式，并提出AVL方法加以防止，在四个机器人控制任务上显著提升视觉扰动下的成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: JEPA类模型在不重建观测的条件下预测未来隐表征，使世界模型聚焦高层语义动力学。但它可能保留高维视觉信息，却丢失关于动作物理后果的信息，该失效模式被称为因果动力学信息坍缩，需要针对性解决。

Method: 提出动作锚定的视觉不变隐表征（AVL）：首先以实际执行的动作作为辅助动力学锚点，促使模型保留动力学信息；其次引入视觉不变通路，在对齐扰动与干净隐预测的同时不丢弃动力学信息，迫使模型充分利用因果动力学信息。

Result: 在TwoRoom、PushT、OGBench Cube、Reacher四个机器人控制任务上，AVL在视觉扰动下大幅提升成功率，并保持干净环境性能；进一步的物理后果对齐、干净-噪声动力学一致性以及定向转移子空间擦除的因果效应评估均支持结论。

Conclusion: AVL可有效防止与规划因果相关的动力学信息发生坍缩，使世界模型在视觉扰动下仍保留并利用动作的物理后果信息。

Abstract: Joint embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) predict future latent representations without reconstructing observations, enabling world models to focus on high-level semantic dynamics. However, a JEPA can preserve high dimensional visual information while discarding information about the physical consequences of actions. We call this failure mode causal dynamics information collapse and propose action-grounded vision-invariance latent (AVL) to prevent this collapse. We first use the executed action as an auxiliary dynamics anchor that encourages the model to preserve dynamics information, and then use a vision-invariance pathway which aligns perturbed and clean latent predictions without discarding dynamics information, forcing the model to fully understand and utilize causal dynamics information. We validate AVL on four robotic control tasks (TwoRoom, PushT, OGBench Cube, and Reacher), showing that it substantially improves success rates under visual perturbations while preserving clean-environment performance. We further evaluate physical consequence alignment, clean-noisy dynamics consistency, and the causal effect of targeted transition subspace erasure. Collectively, these results indicate that dynamic information causally relevant to planning is preserved from collapse under AVL.

</details>


### [156] [World Action Learning via Interaction-Centric Spectral Latent Guidance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03607)
*Zhiming Liu,Yikun Miao,Ying Chen,Hongrui Yin,Fangqi Zhu,Xiaoyi Pang,Quanxin Shou,Zhengyang Yan,Haodong Wang,Song Guo*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: WING是一个从第一视角人类视频向机器人策略迁移交互知识的框架，通过分离观察者运动与手-物交互并利用频谱域低频共享结构引导动作生成，在多个仿真与真实任务上取得高成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用机器人策略依赖大规模真实交互数据，但机器人示教采集昂贵且难以规模化；第一视角（egocentric）视频蕴含丰富的人类操作经验与任务语义，然而直接迁移面临两大障碍：一是从帧重建中推断的隐动作容易被自我相机运动等无关变化主导，二是人与机器人的行为在时间动态上存在差异。

Method: 提出WING框架，包含两个核心步骤：首先将观察者引起的运动与手-物交互分离，并把以交互为中心的分量蒸馏为隐动作（latent actions）；随后基于跨具身任务语义集中于缓慢变化时间结构的观察，在频谱域中识别第一视角隐动作与机器人行为之间的共享低频成分，并以其引导动作生成。

Result: WING在LIBERO上平均成功率达99.20%，RoboTwin 2.0上为93.80%，RoboCasa-GR1上为57.7%，并在四个真实世界操作任务及多种泛化设置下表现优异。

Conclusion: 实验表明，以交互为中心的频谱引导是一种有效且可扩展的方式，能够将人类第一视角视频中的物理交互知识迁移至机器人控制。

Abstract: Learning general-purpose robot policies requires large-scale real-world interaction data, yet collecting robot demonstrations remains expensive and difficult to scale. Egocentric videos offer abundant human interaction experience with task-relevant semantics for robotic manipulation, but direct transfer is challenging for two reasons: latent actions inferred from frame reconstruction can be dominated by nuisance variation such as ego-camera motion, and human and robot behaviors often exhibit different temporal dynamics. We propose WING (World Action Learning via INteraction-Centric Spectral Latent Guidance), a framework for transferring interaction knowledge from egocentric videos to robot policies. WING first separates observer-induced motion from hand-object interaction and distills the interaction-centric component into latent actions. It then exploits the observation that cross-embodiment task semantics are concentrated in slowly varying temporal structures, identifying shared low-frequency components between egocentric latent actions and robot behaviors in the spectral domain and using them to guide action generation. WING achieves average success rates of 99.20% on LIBERO, 93.80% on RoboTwin 2.0, and 57.7% on RoboCasa-GR1, and also performs strongly across four real-world manipulation tasks under diverse generalization settings. These results show that interaction-centric spectral guidance provides an effective and scalable way to transfer physical interaction knowledge from human egocentric video to robot control. Project page: https://mikuz12.github.io/wing/

</details>


### [157] [Bridging Frontier Reasoning and Robot Execution: From Autonomous Demonstration Generation to Dense Language Supervision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03615)
*Bosung Kim,Alexander Trevithick,Ruiyi Wang,Prithviraj Ammanabrolu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文研究两种互补方法，将前沿模型的推理能力与低延迟本地执行相连接：一是利用前沿模型自主生成演示并增强上下文示例以训练快速本地策略；二是引入覆盖原始、原子、复合三层粒度的密集语言监督。二者共同提升长程任务中指令跟随的可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前沿模型能以少量演示实现机器人操作，但其高推理延迟限制实时控制；同时部署时执行瓶颈会转移至本地策略对多样化指令的可靠跟随能力，因此需要弥合前沿推理与低延迟执行之间的鸿沟。

Method: 方法一：用前沿模型自主生成演示，补充人类演示以训练快速本地策略；在上下文示例中加入纠错演示片段，提升生成可靠性；部署时以执行框架将前沿模型指令与本地策略结合。方法二：引入密集语言监督，覆盖原始、原子、复合三种嵌套粒度，并在每层提供多面向描述。

Result: 随成功示例在上下文中积累，生成时间与成本下降；在 RoboCasa 365 与 BEHAVIOR-1K 的长程任务中，指令随执行进程变化，组合监督在 oracle 与前沿模型教师下均取得最高性能。此外在结合语义规划与操作、限定时间预算的填字任务上对两种方法进行了联合评估。

Conclusion: 自主演示生成与密集语言监督可作为互补组件，有效连接前沿推理与低延迟本地执行，支持更可靠的指令跟随。

Abstract: Recent advances in frontier models enable robot manipulation from only a few demonstrations, but high inference latency limits their use for real-time robot control. To bridge this gap, we study two complementary approaches that connect frontier reasoning with low-latency local execution. First, we use a frontier model to autonomously generate demonstrations that supplement human demonstrations for training a fast local policy. We augment its in-context examples with corrective demonstration segments that show how to recover from physical errors, improving generation reliability. Generation time and cost decrease as successful examples accumulate in context, suggesting a path toward more efficient data collection. At deployment, a harness combines frontier-generated instructions with a fast local policy, enabling efficient execution while preserving the frontier model's ability to guide and correct actions. With low-latency execution delegated to the local policy, the bottleneck shifts to its capacity to reliably follow the frontier model's diverse instructions. Our second bridge introduces dense language supervision across three nested granularities---primitive, atomic, and composite---with multi-aspect descriptions at each level. Across long-horizon tasks in RoboCasa 365 and BEHAVIOR-1K, where instructions change as execution progresses, the combined supervision achieves the highest performance under both oracle and frontier-model instructors, demonstrating more reliable instruction following through the policy's language interface. Finally, we evaluate both bridges together on a crossword task that combines semantic planning and manipulation within a fixed time budget. These results support autonomous demonstration generation and dense language supervision as complementary components for connecting frontier reasoning to low-latency local execution.

</details>


### [158] [LLA-MPC on Embedded Hardware: Rapid Adaptive Control with Thousands of Parallel Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03616)
*Henry Z. Liao,Maitham F. AL-Sunni,John M. Dolan*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了LLA-MPC（Look-Back and Look-Ahead Adaptive MPC）的通用化实现，一种无需学习的实时自适应系统辨识与控制框架，并在F1TENTH平台上于受限算力和噪声状态估计条件下完成实车验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 原始LLA-MPC仅在仿真中验证，且局限于固定模型结构的自动驾驶竞速任务，缺乏模块化设计与真实硬件、受限算力条件下的验证，因此需要通用化实现并证明其在现实平台上的有效性。

Method: 采用模块化的动力学模型与积分器设计；在嵌入式计算机上实时评估数千个候选模型以在线辨识轮胎参数；在F1TENTH平台上于受限计算与噪声状态估计条件下进行实验验证。

Result: 在使用低摩擦轮胎并跨越变化路面的实验中，LLA-MPC能够完成固定标称模型失败的高速跟踪任务。

Conclusion: LLA-MPC的通用化实现在真实嵌入式平台上可行，具备在算力受限与状态估计噪声条件下进行实时自适应辨识与控制的能力，性能优于固定模型方案。

Abstract: We present a generalized implementation of Look-Back and Look-Ahead Adaptive Model Predictive Control (LLA-MPC), a learning-free framework for real-time, rapid adaptive system identification and control. The original formulation was demonstrated only in simulation, for autonomous racing with a fixed model structure. Our implementation has modular dynamics and integrators, and we validate it on the F1TENTH platform under constrained computation and noisy state estimation. The system identifies tire parameters online by evaluating thousands of candidate models in real time on an embedded computer. Experiments with low-friction tires across changing surfaces show that LLA-MPC completes high-speed tracking tasks where a fixed nominal model fails. Code, videos, and our related work are available at: https://lla-control.github.io.

</details>


### [159] [CORNAV: Construction-Aware Reasoning for Robot Navigation on Active Worksites](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03622)
*Parastoo Ali Pour,Deepak Prakash Kumar,Tommy Zhou,Pramod Khargonekar,Mohammad Abdullah Al Faruque*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: CORNAV 是一个基于图纸与进度计划约束的施工工地自主导航框架，无需 BIM，通过 CAD 图纸与 3D 场景图对齐、进度表转时变约束、LLM 安全校验与 A* 规划，将任务成功率从 13.0% 提升至 72.2%，并消除硬禁区违规。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 建筑行业长期面临劳动力短缺、生产率低下（每年给全球经济造成超1.6万亿美元损失）以及高工伤率问题，因此需要自主机器人提升效率与工人安全。但现有语言引导导航系统仅依赖语义场景理解，缺乏建筑领域专用上下文（如建筑图纸、动态工期、安全约束），导致永久建筑特征定位不可靠，无法在活跃工地上安全导航。

Method: 提出 CORNAV：从2D CAD图纸与项目进度表出发，不依赖BIM。方法包括：1）将建筑蓝图与分层开放词汇3D场景图对齐，以落地物体查询；2）将项目进度表转换为时变导航约束；3）通过基于LLM的安全模块校验请求，在规划前对危险区域进行升级处理；4）由A*规划器执行强制禁区约束，并优先规避高风险区域。

Result: 在室内办公室与真实施工工地两类场景中验证：图纸落地相较纯语义检索将任务成功率从13.0%提升至72.2%；进度感知消除了全部硬禁区违规；安全模块能够正确拒绝由项目进度表错误标注引发的危险请求。

Conclusion: 建筑专用上下文（图纸、进度、安全约束）的引入对施工工地自主导航至关重要。CORNAV 证明了在无BIM条件下，结合蓝图落地、进度感知与LLM安全校验可显著提升导航可靠性与安全性。

Abstract: The construction industry faces persistent labor shortages, low productivity that costs the global economy over $1.6 trillion annually, and one of the highest injury rates among major industries. These factors motivate the use of autonomous robots to improve efficiency and worker safety. Existing language-grounded navigation systems, however, rely on semantic scene understanding alone and lack access to construction-specific context such as architectural plans, evolving work schedules, and safety constraints. As a result, they localize permanent building features unreliably and cannot safely navigate active jobsites. We present CORNAV, a blueprint-grounded, schedule-aware navigation framework that operates from 2D CAD drawings and project schedules without requiring a Building Information Model. CORNAV aligns architectural blueprints against hierarchical open-vocabulary 3D scene graphs to ground object queries, converts project schedules into time-varying navigation constraints, and validates requests through an LLM-based safety module that escalates hazardous zones before planning. An A* planner then enforces mandatory exclusion zones while preferentially avoiding higher-risk areas. Across an indoor office and a real construction site, blueprint grounding raises task success from 13.0% to 72.2% over semantic retrieval alone, schedule awareness eliminates all hard-zone violations, and the safety module correctly rejects hazardous requests arising from mislabeled project schedules.

</details>


### [160] [EyeRobot 2.0: Active Gaze for Precise Manipulation without Wrist Cameras](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03710)
*Kush Hari,Justin Kerr,Nidhya Shivakumar,Samarth Mahapatra,Carmelo Sferrazza,Jiahui Lei,Jitendra Malik,C. Karen Liu,Ken Goldberg,Angjoo Kanazawa*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出EyeRobot 2.0，用主动注视（AVF）仅凭单个双目相机实现精细双臂操作，通过分层RL训练注视伺服与目标选择，并将夹爪信息规范化到注视相对SE(3)坐标系，性能显著优于被动双目，并在遮挡时超过自我中心+腕部相机策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类视觉通过主动注视将高分辨率资源集中在任务相关区域；而机器人精细双臂操作通常依赖腕部相机补充视角，移除腕部相机会使标准策略性能大幅下降。作者希望仅用单个双目相机、借助主动注视来弥补这一信息缺口，从而在降低硬件需求的同时保持甚至提升精细操作能力。

Method: 提出Active Visual Fixation（AVF）框架：物理上旋转两个眼视角对准3D注视点，并对图像中心分配更多视觉token进行foveal处理以聚焦计算。采用分层结构：先训练以目标物体为条件的低层注视伺服策略（密集几何奖励的RL，真实数据），再训练目标选择器，根据任务进度输出注视目标；目标选择器与BC夹爪策略协同训练，从而发现类人的注视序列。此外将夹爪信息规范化到注视相对SE(3)坐标系，压缩动作分布。使用7个真实任务与6个仿真任务的遥操作数据，进行1000+真实与1800+仿真试验，与被动双目及自我中心+腕部相机策略对比。

Result: 仅被动双目时真实成功率从52%降至27%，而EyeRobot 2.0仅用双目即缩小该差距：真实场景比被动双目高40%、仿真高20%。在腕部视角清晰时与自我中心+腕部策略相当（69% vs 64%）；当抓取物体遮挡腕部相机时成功率超过其两倍以上（48% vs 22%）。

Conclusion: 主动注视可使单双目相机配置达到甚至超越多相机策略的精细双臂操作性能，尤其在腕部视角被遮挡时优势明显，验证了注视机制与注视相对动作规范化的有效性。

Abstract: Inspired by human vision, we introduce a framework using active gaze to enable fine-grained bimanual manipulation with only a single stereo camera. EyeRobot 2.0 physically attends to a 3D fixation point in the scene by swiveling two eye viewpoints to center their gaze on it. The resulting images are processed foveally by allocating more visual tokens to the image centers, focusing computation on task-relevant features. Such Active Visual Fixation (AVF) requires carefully coordinated gaze during task execution, which we accomplish hierarchically by first training a low-level gaze servoing policy conditioned on a goal object, then training a target selector which emits fixation goals based on task progress. Both modules are trained with RL on real-world data: the first is trained with a dense geometric reward and the second co-trains with the BC gripper policy which allows it to discover fixation sequences that can resemble a human's fixation sequence while performing the task. EyeRobot 2.0 further takes advantage of fixation by canonicalizing gripper information into a fixation-relative SE(3) frame, which compacts the size of the action distribution to learn. We collect teleoperation data for 7 real-world and 6 simulated tasks, and conduct over 1000 physical and 1800 simulated robot trials comparing EyeRobot 2.0 against passive stereo and ego + wrist camera policies trained on the same data. Removing wrist cameras is costly for standard policies: with only passive stereo, real-world success drops from 52% to 27%. EyeRobot 2.0 closes this gap with only stereo, outperforming passive stereo by 40% in real and 20% in sim. It matches ego + wrist policies when their wrist views are clear (69% vs. 64%), and more than doubles their success when grasped objects occlude the wrist cameras (48% vs. 22%)

</details>

### [161] [MintFlow: Minimal Trajectory Intervention for Constrained Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02260)
*Yesom Park,Kelvin Kan,Qifan Chen,Thomas Flynn,Hayden Schaeffer. Xihaier Luo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MintFlow是一种免训练的约束采样框架，通过最小化对预训练流轨迹的干预来施加约束，在满足约束的同时显著减少对预训练数据分布的偏离。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流匹配模型擅长生成建模，但下游应用常要求样本满足观测测量、物理定律等约束。现有约束采样器存在权衡：强制满足约束会使样本大幅偏离预训练数据分布。因此需要一种既能满足约束又能最小化分布偏离的方法。

Method: 将约束施加建模为对预训练流轨迹的最小干预：寻找对中间流状态的最小扰动，使其在预训练流场下的后续演化满足目标约束。通过保持预训练流场不变、仅最小扰动流状态，兼顾约束满足与分布保持。采用伴随（adjoint）公式推导该扰动的闭式解，无需昂贵迭代优化；并自适应选择干预时刻，以平衡所需扰动幅度与其在剩余流中被放大的程度。

Result: 在生成视觉和物理系统建模的多种任务中，MintFlow在约束满足方面具有竞争力，同时在保持预训练生成分布方面显著优于当前最先进的约束方法。

Conclusion: MintFlow提供了一种免训练、无需迭代优化的约束采样方案，有效缓解了约束满足与分布保持之间的权衡，在视觉生成与物理系统建模任务中展现优势。

Abstract: Flow matching models excel at generative modeling, and many downstream applications require their samples to satisfy prescribed constraints, such as observed measurements and physical laws. However, existing constrained samplers often face a trade-off: \textit{enforcing constraints can substantially displace samples from the pretrained data distribution}. To address this trade-off, we introduce \textbf{MintFlow}, a training-free constrained sampling framework that formulates constraint enforcement as a minimal intervention on the pretrained flow trajectory. MintFlow seeks the minimal perturbation of an intermediate flow state such that its subsequent evolution under the pretrained flow field satisfies the target constraint. By minimally perturbing the flow state while keeping the pretrained flow field unchanged, MintFlow enforces the constraint while minimizing unnecessary deviation from the pretrained distribution. An adjoint formulation yields a closed-form expression for this perturbation, eliminating expensive iterative optimization. Furthermore, MintFlow adaptively selects the intervention time to balance the required perturbation magnitude with its amplification by the remaining flow. Across a range of tasks in generative vision and physical system modeling, MintFlow achieves competitive constraint satisfaction while preserving the pretrained generative distribution substantially better than state-of-the-art constrained methods.

</details>


### [162] [Fast Models, Slow Evidence: A Paired and Self-Audited Evaluation of System-1 Decision Models for LLM Agent Harnesses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02267)
*Jiawei Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 对开源(Laya)与托管(Jev)两个System-1决策模型在11个Agent决策点上进行配对评测(7,283基础案例+6,640鲁棒变体)，并审计自身分析流程。Jev在9/11决策点上显著更准(+10.8至+46.0 pp)；两模型在零样本模型路由上均不优于随机，在RAG相关性门控上持平；Laya对选项顺序敏感(30%答案翻转)。作者还披露三处分析错误与一处设计混淆，修正后部署收益从23.9%降至4.3%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Agent harness每任务需做大量小型类型化决策(选模型、选工具、判断检索相关性、检测注入)，调用LLM成本高、延迟大。System-1决策模型单次前向传播给类概率，理论上可大幅节省成本与延迟，但其在真实Agent决策点上的准确性与鲁棒性尚缺乏严格的配对评测证据，且既有部署收益宣称可能受分析错误影响。

Method: 构建11个决策点、来自18个公开来源的评测集：7,283基础案例+6,640鲁棒变体；对开源模型Laya与托管模型Jev使用字节级相同输入、配对显著性检验，并进行跨硬件、跨天复现性检查。鲁棒性探测包括选项顺序反转、候选数量与相似度压力测试。同时对自身分析流程做审计，识别并修正分析错误与设计混淆。

Result: Jev在9/11决策点上显著更准(+10.8至+46.0 pp)；两模型在零样本模型路由上均不优于随机；RAG相关性门控上打平。Laya在选项顺序反转时30%答案改变，且在候选多或相似时性能骤降(50个最近邻工具时31%，而Jev在唯一正确工具项上达98%)。审计发现三处分析错误与一处设计混淆：遗漏预筛成本(宣称节省23.9%，实际4.3%)、将门控准确率当作端到端质量(58% vs 98%)、样本内阈值(目标5%，留出集漏检达17%)，以及随渠道原生内容消失的注入假阳性"渠道效应"；另两处疑似混淆不影响结论。

Conclusion: System-1决策模型在多数Agent决策点上仍显著弱于更强模型，且在顺序敏感性、候选规模与相似度下鲁棒性不足，零样本路由能力缺失；成本节省宣称需扣除预筛开销并区分门控准确率与端到端质量。研究强调严格配对评测、鲁棒性测试与对自身分析管道的审计，并公开全部案例、原始输出与分析代码以保证可复现。

Abstract: Agent harnesses make many small, typed decisions per task: which model to call, which tool to use, whether retrieved text is relevant, whether an input carries an injection. System-1 decision models answer such questions in a single forward pass with class probabilities, promising large cost and latency savings over LLM calls. We present a paired evaluation of an open-weight (Laya) and a hosted (Jev) System-1 model on 11 agent decision points built from 18 public sources: 7,283 base cases plus 6,640 robustness variants, with byte-identical inputs, paired tests, and cross-hardware and cross-day reproducibility checks. Jev is significantly more accurate on 9 of 11 decision points (+10.8 to +46.0 pp). Neither model beats chance on zero-shot model routing, and they tie on RAG relevance gating. Laya changes 30% of its answers when the option order is reversed and degrades sharply with many or similar candidates (31% at 50 nearest-neighbour tools, vs. 98% for Jev on items with a unique correct tool). We also audit our own pipeline. Three analysis errors and one design confound distorted headline deployment claims: an omitted pre-screen cost (reported 23.9% saving, actual 4.3%), gate accuracy reported as end-to-end quality (58% vs. 98%), in-sample thresholds (5% target, up to 17% held-out misses), and a "channel effect" on injection false positives that vanishes with channel-native content. Two other suspected confounds did not change the conclusions. All cases, raw outputs and analysis code are available at https://github.com/David-DL-Space/sys1-eval.

</details>


### [163] [The AI Risk Observatory: What Can We Learn from AI Disclosures in Annual Reports About Societal Resilience?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02281)
*Bart Jaworski*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究用可复现的两阶段LLM分类流程分析1,362家英国上市公司9,821份年报（2020–2025，含部分2026数据），发现AI风险披露占比从2.8%升至41.2%，AI采用披露从13.8%升至45.2%，但实质性AI风险披露仅占4.3%，且披露水平在关键国家基础设施行业与市场板块间差异显著。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 社会韧性研究依赖有用且可操作的数据，因此作者提出核心问题：规模化处理年报能否为公司如何披露其AI响应提供有效信号。

Method: 采用可复现的两阶段分类流程，对1,362家英国上市公司2020–2025年（含部分2026年）的9,821份年报进行LLM规模化处理；先用474条人工标注段落验证方法，并构建"实质性"分类以评估披露质量。

Result: 方法验证显示高召回率、标签层面一致性中等。三项实证规律：(i) 2020–2025年提及AI风险的报告占比由2.8%升至41.2%，AI采用披露由13.8%升至45.2%，具名供应商集中于以Microsoft为首的主要厂商；(ii) 披露在关键国家基础设施行业与市场板块间差异明显，AIM报告AI风险披露率远低于主板，能源与数据基础设施等行业滞后；(iii) 危害披露几乎缺席（全语料仅7份报告）。质量上，2025年41.2%报告提及AI风险，但仅4.3%属实质性披露。

Conclusion: 年报经LLM规模化处理可提供关于公司AI响应披露的有效信号，但总体AI风险披露多为非实质性，且行业与市场板块间存在显著不均衡。

Abstract: Societal resilience research relies on access to useful and actionable data, which motivates our main research question: Can annual reports, processed at scale with LLMs, provide a useful signal about how companies disclose their response to AI? We test this by applying a reproducible two-stage classification pipeline to 9,821 annual reports from 1,362 UK listed companies (2020-2025, with partial 2026 data). We first validate the method against 474 human-annotated passages, finding high recall and moderate label-level agreement. We then report three empirical patterns: (i) between 2020 and 2025, the share of reports mentioning AI risk rose from 2.8% to 41.2%, while AI adoption disclosure also rose, from 13.8% to 45.2%, and named vendor mentions cluster around a small set of major providers led by Microsoft; (ii) disclosure varies substantially by Critical National Infrastructure sector and market segment: AIM reports disclose AI risk at far lower rates than Main Market reports, and sectors such as Energy and Data Infrastructure lag behind the rest in AI risk disclosure; and (iii) harm disclosures are near-absent (seven reports across the entire corpus). We develop a substantiveness classification to assess the quality of the disclosure and find that most AI risk disclosure is not substantive: in 2025, 41.2% of all reports mention AI as a risk, but only 4.3% contain AI risk disclosure we classify as substantive.

</details>


### [164] [Keep It CALM: Analyzing the Limits of Global Unsafety in Text-to-Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02300)
*NaHyeon Park,Minhyun Lee,Hyunjung Shim*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文揭示现有免训练文本到图像安全防护中"全局不安全信号"存在覆盖度-选择性的固有权衡，并提出 CALM 方法，用提示局部反事实校正替代全局统一去除，从而在抑制不安全内容的同时更好保留良性生成能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有免训练防护方法普遍假设存在可复用的全局安全信号（如不安全方向或全局有毒子空间），并跨提示统一应用。作者希望通过受控的几何分析检验这一"全局不安全"假设，并发现其内在缺陷：紧凑的不安全子空间无法覆盖异构的不安全语义；而扩大聚合范围又会扭曲与安全相邻的良性提示，形成覆盖度与选择性之间的权衡。

Method: 提出 CALM（Counterfactual Adaptive Local Modulation）。该方法免训练，用提示局部的反事实校正取代全局统一去除：利用配对的不安全-良性锚点，为每个提示路由到其活跃的不安全类别；只对违反安全性的 token 表示朝安全方向进行最小编辑；并抑制正向对齐的不安全残差分量。

Result: 在广泛评估中，CALM 在显著提升不安全内容抑制效果的同时，保持了良性提示的生成效用，表明局部反事实校正相比全局不安全信号去除具有更好的选择性。

Conclusion: 通过受控几何分析，论文证明全局不安全信号存在覆盖度-选择性的权衡缺陷，而基于提示局部反事实校正的 CALM 是一种更具选择性的替代方案，为免训练文本到图像安全防护提供了新思路。

Abstract: Training-free safeguards for text-to-image generation often rely on a reusable safety signal, such as an unsafe direction or global toxic subspace, applied broadly across prompts. We provide a controlled geometric analysis of this global-unsafety assumption and reveal a consistent coverage-selectivity trade-off: compact unsafe subspaces fail to cover heterogeneous unsafe semantics, whereas broader aggregation increasingly distorts safety-adjacent benign prompts. Motivated by this finding, we propose CALM (Counterfactual Adaptive Local Modulation), a training-free safeguard that replaces uniform global removal with prompt-local counterfactual correction. Using matched unsafe-benign anchors, CALM routes each prompt to active unsafe categories, minimally edits only violating token representations toward the safe side, and suppresses positively aligned unsafe residual components. Across broad evaluation, CALM significantly improves unsafe content suppression while preserving benign utility, demonstrating that local counterfactual correction provides a more selective alternative to global unsafe signal removal.

</details>


### [165] [Choosing Before Acting: Comparative Value Estimation for Long-Horizon Tool-Use Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02330)
*Yu Li,Zheng Zhang,Xin Liu,Shengtian Yang,Guangfeng Cai,Lei Feng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 CITA 框架，通过构建比较式推理模型（CIM）估计工具调用的长时程价值，提升工具使用智能体的 Tool F1 与任务成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时程工具调用中，最终结果奖励难以对长交互轨迹进行有效的信用分配；而步骤级奖励往往依赖人工/LLM判断或额外 rollout 来估计中间决策的下游影响，代价高且不稳定。因此需要一种在执行前就能评估候选取工具调用长时程价值的方法。

Method: CITA 训练比较式推理模型（CIM），其监督信号来自三类配对信号：观察到的工具行为、来自贝叶斯工具图模拟器的可扩展监督、以及基于 LLM 的语义比较判断。CIM 学习在当前上下文下估计某个可能的下一步工具调用支持最终任务成功的可能性。

Result: 在三个工具使用基准和多个骨干 LLM 上，CITA 一致提升 Tool F1 与任务成功率；额外分析表明 CIM 能为比较式工具选择学习到准确的步骤级价值估计。

Conclusion: 通过在执行前对候选取工具调用进行长时程价值的比较式推理，可有效改善长时程工具使用的信用分配问题，CITA 在多基准、多主干模型上验证了其有效性。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) rely on long-horizon tool invocation sequences for complex tasks, where each invocation can alter the task state and condition subsequent decisions. In long-horizon tool use, final-outcome rewards provide weak credit assignment over long interaction traces. Step-level rewards can offer more targeted feedback, but obtaining reliable step supervision often requires human or LLM judgment, or additional rollouts to estimate the downstream effect of an intermediate decision. In this paper, we argue that effective tool-use agents should estimate the long-horizon value of a possible next tool invocation before executing it. This objective requires comparative supervision over alternative invocations under the same context, while logged trajectories only contain the invocation that was actually taken. Therefore, we propose Comparative Inference for Tool-use Agents (CITA). CITA trains a Comparative Inference Model (CIM) from paired signals that combine observed tool behavior, scalable supervision from a Bayesian tool-graph simulator, and semantic judgments from LLM-based comparison. The resulting CIM learns to estimate how likely a possible next tool invocation is to support final task success under the current context. Across three tool-use benchmarks and multiple backbone LLMs, CITA consistently improves Tool F1 and task success. Additional analysis shows that CIM learns accurate step-level value estimates for comparative tool choices.

</details>


### [166] [World Editing: Intervening on Executable Worlds at Increasing Depth](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02331)
*Max Ku,Nok-Kan Law,Yu-Chien Tang,Shih-Ying Yeh,Ping Nie,Andy Zheng,Tat Hei Lai,Fei-Yueh Chen,Nikko Yu,Wei-Chieh Sun,Suzy Huang,Chiao-Wei Hsu,Chih-Chuan Huang,Chak-Wing Mak,Ho Yin Sam Ng,Edisy Kin Wai Chan,Min-Hung Chen,Ho Kei Cheng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文将"世界编辑"形式化为对现有可执行世界的干预，提出干预深度这一维度，并以游戏模组为场景构建IGMWorld与IGMBench（110任务、1.1K+可执行标准），评测前沿编程智能体的世界编辑能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 交互式世界模型已能生成环境并在其中行动，但"有意地编辑一个已有可执行世界"仍研究不足；需要区分世界编辑与世界生成、世界交互，并建立可度量的评测范式。

Method: 将世界编辑形式化为对现有世界的干预，同时保持应不变的性质；提出干预深度（property、entity、dynamics、system 等层级）刻画编辑对实体、动态与系统的耦合强度；以工业级游戏模组实例化，构建IGMWorld及IGMBench基准，含110个任务、1100+可执行状态与行为判据，覆盖Minecraft与Terraria；通过确定性可执行性、行为、保持性（preservation）与视觉检查进行评测。

Result: 最强配置在严格任务级标准下解决78.2%的任务，判据级达94.8%；可靠性随干预深度增加而下降，且在判据数量相近的任务间依然成立；多数失败编辑仍能成功构建并加载，说明主要难点在于让编辑后的世界按要求运行；视觉一致性是独立短板，所有配置联合视觉通过率均低于50%。

Conclusion: 世界编辑是与世界生成和交互不同的独立能力；可执行游戏为研究该能力提供了实用测试床。

Abstract: Interactive world models are increasingly capable of generating environments and acting within them, yet deliberately editing an existing executable world remains underexplored. We formulate world editing as intervening on an existing world while preserving properties that should remain unchanged, and introduce intervention depth as an axis describing how strongly an edit couples world entities, dynamics, and systems. We instantiate this capability through industry-grade game modding and introduce IGMWorld, together with IGMBench, a benchmark of 110 tasks and over 1.1K executable state and behavioral criteria across Minecraft and Terraria. The tasks span property, entity, dynamics, and system interventions and are evaluated through deterministic executability, behavioral, preservation, and visual checks.
